title: 2 Year Apprenticeship Programme (m/f/d)
description: **Damovo** is a global managed ICT solutions and services company. Damovo Global Services is the global delivery organisation within the Damovo Group. Headquartered in and managed from **Dublin** , we support many large Fortune 500 companies across the world. Our operations span over 150 countries with a local presence in Ireland, UK, Poland, Germany, Belgium, Luxembourg, Netherlands, USA, Costa Rica, Philippines, Singapore and Malaysia. **Overview** Our **2\-year apprenticeship programme** offers the opportunity to join an agile, fast\-moving organisation. As part of a team of 600 employees, you can expect to work in a very open and agile culture, where freedom to voice your ideas is encouraged and facilitated through flat structures and supportive management. Upon completion of the apprenticeship, you will have Unified Communication experience across various technologies such as Microsoft Teams, Genesys and Cisco Webex which will help in your further career progression in the industry. At Damovo we are passionate about enabling complete connection – across people, processes and systems. We improve the way people collaborate using the very latest digital technologies from the world’s leading technology vendors – including Microsoft, Avaya, Cisco and Mitel. Our portfolio of managed communication and collaboration services create transparency and agility whilst also providing the network resilience and security our customers’ demand. You will be supporting both Irish and global customers. This varied role will provide the successful candidate with on\-the\-job training, working with experienced professionals providing valuable insights into a variety of different fields of expertise. **What is involved in the Damovo apprenticeship?** You will study towards a Higher Certificate in Telecommunications and Data Network Engineering, which is a technician apprenticeship by successfully completing all external assessments through TU Dublin, Tallaght. You will develop skills both on\-site and in the classroom. Whilst in the classroom you will cover Network Installation, Health and Safety, Telecommunications and Technology \& Service Restoration, Electrical Principals, Customer Service, Broadband \& Wireless Skills, Optic Fibre Installation, Maintenance \& Commissioning and Personal \& Professional Development. You will bring what you have learned in the classroom into the workplace where you will not only get to put what you have learned into practice, but will also get hands on experience with: * Maintaining computer environments both on\-premise and in the cloud * Maintaining and managing the Testing Environment in our internal laboratory. This will include ensuring all equipment and applications, both physical and virtual, are viable and fit for purpose with the support of the relevant senior engineers * Monitoring computer systems to improve performance for all systems * Troubleshooting, resolving, and communicating issues to other employees and management * Other relevant learning opportunities as they arise **What we are looking for** * Leaving Certificate completion * Willingness to learn Unified Communications and Contact Center technologies through both on\-the\-job and classroom\-led learning * Good computer literacy and a strong interest in a career in IT * Customer service experience * A good communicator, both written and verbal * Excellent problem\-solving skills * Proactive, can\-do attitude demonstrating initiative * Can work well both individually and as part of a team * The ability to attend TU Dublin (Tallaght) and to commute to our offices * A commitment to successfully complete the 2\-year apprenticeship * Full driving licence with access to your own vehicle, as travel to customer sites will be necessary as part of the role

title: 2027 BNY Summer Internship Program - Audit (Dublin)
description: **Job Description** **Audit Practice** Internal Audit is an independent function at BNY that helps the organization succeed by assessing the adequacy and effectiveness of the internal control environment. Through a combination of risk assurance and advisory support, the team provides analyses, insights, and recommendations that promote effective risk management and control. Interns in Internal Audit receive targeted on\-the\-job training and work alongside experienced audit professionals to build technical knowledge, strengthen soft skills, and learn how audit drives impact across the organization. **What You Will Do** * Support audit work by reviewing processes, risks, and controls across different parts of BNY’s business and operations. * Help analyze information, document observations, and identify themes that may point to control gaps, inefficiencies, or opportunities to improve. * Contribute to audit testing, walkthroughs, and reporting that help teams understand how effectively processes and controls are working. * Partner with audit professionals and business stakeholders to gather information, ask thoughtful questions, and translate findings into clear, actionable insights. * Gain exposure to how governance, risk management, and internal controls support a global financial services company. **Skills You Will Build** * Risk and control thinking * Analytical problem\-solving and critical thinking * Business process analysis * Written communication and concise reporting * Professional skepticism and sound judgment * Collaboration and stakeholder communication * Attention to detail and documentation discipline **Impact you will have at BNY** * Help teams identify risks earlier and improve how key processes and controls operate. * Contribute to work that promotes accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement across the organization. * Support insights and recommendations that help protect the firm and strengthen the control environment. * See how independent review and objective analysis create real value in a complex global business. **Why this could be a fit for you** This role is a great fit if you like asking smart questions, solving problems, connecting details to the bigger picture, and doing work that helps organizations operate more effectively and responsibly. **Summer Internship Program** The BNY Summer Internship Program offers high\-potential students a dynamic 10\-week experience designed to accelerate development, build professional networks, and provide meaningful exposure to one of the world's leading financial services institutions. Through a skills\-driven talent model, interns gain insight into the capabilities, platforms, and functions that power BNY's global franchise while contributing to impactful business initiatives. From day one, interns are immersed in BNY's collaborative and innovative culture through: * Enterprise\-wide onboarding and development programming, including an in person immersive induction experience, executive speaker series, skill development, and networking opportunities. * Meaningful project work aligned to key business practices and platforms, providing hands\-on experience, skill development, and real\-world business impact. * Structured mentorship and career support from managers, senior leaders, peer mentors, business stakeholders, and dedicated program managers. * Exposure across practices, platforms, and teams, building a broad understanding of BNY's integrated business model. * Professional, technical, and financial services training designed to strengthen business acumen and prepare participants for long\-term career success. * A premier early\-career experience, backed by senior leadership and designed to develop the next generation of talent for BNY's global workforce. **Program Eligibility** * Enrollment in a 3 or 4\-year undergraduate degree program with a strong focus on business\-related and/or technology\-related majors preferred * Graduating in Dec 2027 or Summer 2028 * On track to achieve a 2\.1 or higher * Does not require sponsorship for employment visa status (now or in the future) in the country where applying. **About Us** At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting\-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide. Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary. **About The Team** At BNY, our culture speaks for itself, check out the latest BNY news at: BNY Newsroom \& BNY LinkedIn **Here’s a Few Of Our Recent Awards** * America’s Most Innovative Companies, Fortune, 2025 * World’s Most Admired Companies, Fortune 2025 * “Most Just Companies”, Just Capital and CNBC, 2025 **Our Benefits And Rewards** BNY offers highly competitive compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs rooted in a strong culture of excellence and our pay\-for\-performance philosophy. We provide access to flexible global resources and tools for your life’s journey. Focus on your health, foster your personal resilience, and reach your financial goals as a valued member of our team, along with generous paid leaves, including paid volunteer time, that can support you and your family through moments that matter. BNY is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer \- Underrepresented racial and ethnic groups/Females/Individuals with Disabilities/Protected Veterans.

title: 2K Games - Engineering Graduate Program - Dublin
description: Founded in 2005, 2K Games is a global video game company, publishing titles developed by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Our studios responsible for developing 2K’s portfolio of world\-class games across multiple platforms, include Visual Concepts, Firaxis, Hangar 13, CatDaddy, Cloud Chamber, and HB Studios. Our portfolio of titles is expanding due to our global strategic plan, building, and acquiring exciting studios whose content continues to inspire all of us! 2K publishes titles in today’s most popular gaming genres, including sports, shooters, action, role\-playing, strategy, casual, and family entertainment. Our team of engineers, marketers, artists, writers, data scientists, producers, problem solvers, and doers, are the professional publishing stewards of our growing library of critically acclaimed franchises such as NBA 2K, Battleborn, BioShock, Borderlands, PGA TOUR 2K, Mafia, Sid Meier’s Civilization, WWE 2K, and XCOM. At 2K, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment, which means encouraging our teams to Come as You Are and do your best work! We are dedicated to diversity and inclusion and want our community of candidates to reflect this commitment. We encourage all qualified applicants to explore our global positions. Kickstart your career with 2K’s Engineering Graduate Program. **Program Overview** The Engineering Graduate Program starts July 2027\. Based out of our Dublin, Vancouver and US offices, launch your career in game development over a 21 month period. * Foundation Training (3 Months): Master game development fundamentals using industry\-standard engines, engage in instructor\-led projects, receive guided feedback \& reviews, and develop essential soft skills for working in a studio environment. * Studio Rotations (18 Months): Complete 3 rotations across 2K studios (such as Hangar 13, Visual Concepts, Firaxis, HB Studios, Gearbox, and more), contributing directly to AAA titles. **What You Will Do** * Collaborate with multi\-disciplinary engineering teams to build and support game features across our titles. * Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code, primarily in C\+\+ \& in the Unreal Engine. * Participate in instructor\-led group projects, technical workshops, and guided reviews. * Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize systems across diverse engineering platforms and game engines. * Adapt quickly to varied studio workflows, version control tools (e.g., Perforce), and game release timelines. **Who You Are** * Graduated between January 2025 and July 2027 with a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or a related technical field. * Proficiency in programming languages such as C\+\+, C\#, or Python. * Experience with the use of Unreal Engine, which will be evaluated during the assessment process. * Strong understanding of algorithms, data structures, and software design patterns. * Solid debugging, analytical, and problem\-solving abilities with strong attention to detail. * Proactive, curious learner with a genuine passion for gaming and technology. **How To Apply** The next cohort of engineers will join us in July 2027\. We will open recruitment starting on September 14th and encourage you to apply today and not wait before it is too late! Apply with a CV/resume and full information regarding academic history as requested on the application portal. Be sure to include any additional links (GitHub, itch.io, etc) to show us some of the cool things that you do! As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to ensuring that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform their essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us if you need a reasonable accommodation. Please note that 2K Games and its studios never use instant messaging apps or personal email accounts to contact prospective employees or conduct interviews and when emailing, recruiters only use 2K.com, take2games.com or zynga.com accounts.

title: 2K Games - Publishing Graduate Program - Dublin
description: Founded in 2005, 2K Games is a global video game company, publishing titles developed by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Our studios responsible for developing 2K’s portfolio of world\-class games across multiple platforms, include Visual Concepts, Firaxis, Hangar 13, CatDaddy, Cloud Chamber, and HB Studios. Our portfolio of titles is expanding due to our global strategic plan, building, and acquiring exciting studios whose content continues to inspire all of us! 2K publishes titles in today’s most popular gaming genres, including sports, shooters, action, role\-playing, strategy, casual, and family entertainment. Our team of engineers, marketers, artists, writers, data scientists, producers, problem solvers, and doers, are the professional publishing stewards of our growing library of critically acclaimed franchises such as NBA 2K, Battleborn, BioShock, Borderlands, PGA TOUR 2K, Mafia, Sid Meier’s Civilization, WWE 2K, and XCOM. At 2K, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment, which means encouraging our teams to Come as You Are and do your best work! We are dedicated to diversity and inclusion and want our community of candidates to reflect this commitment. We encourage all qualified applicants to explore our global positions. Publishing Graduate Program Our graduate program is a rotation\-based journey through our business, based in Dublin, London or Novato, with the possibility of a rotation in one of our international offices. You'll help shape your own experience as we match your learning goals to our business needs. What is the Publishing Graduate Program? When people hear ‘publishing,’ they usually think “books”. At 2K, it means everything that happens outside of game development to bring games to market and get them in front of players: advertising, budget planning, marketing technology, live services, growth strategy, player insights and analytics, and go\-to\-market planning. Our rotations give you hands\-on experience across the whole publishing organisation. Before You Apply... Who are we looking for? We hire less for a specific degree and more for how you think and work. Across the business, the graduates who thrive tend to be curious, take ownership of their work and think critically about what they're being asked to do, as well as take feedback well. Beyond that, our graduates join us from science, economics, engineering, philosophy, social sciences, arts, and everywhere in between. Our recruitment process is task\-based, so you get a real chance to show what you can do. Once you're in, our foundation training and ongoing development mean you're never figuring it out alone. We consider a “recent graduate” to be anyone who has graduated within two years of the program (January 2025 \- June 2027\) start date in July 2027\. Do I have to be a gamer? Not at all. Some of our graduates have never played a game, while others play every day, and both bring perspectives that we value. Whether you're an avid gamer or picking up a controller for the first time, you'll have a point of view to bring to any team you join. How do we recruit? We keep our process short and straightforward, because we know applying for jobs is stressful enough. We hire for analytical thinking, tested across three areas: quantitative skills, qualitative skills, and how quickly you pick up something new. Combined with your interview, that's how we get a sense of the curiosity, drive and critical thinking we're looking for. If that sounds like you, we'd love to receive your application. What Will I Be Doing? The program starts with training to set you up with foundational skills. After that, you'll take on a maximum of six three\-month rotations across our publishing teams, from marketing and brand to product and player science. By the end of the program, you'll walk away with three core skill sets: analytical, technical, and commercial. We don't expect people to arrive with all three, and that's the point. We're looking for people with the potential to grow, and we'll help you get there. You can explore each rotation in detail on our graduate programme page. What Happens After the Program? By the end of the program, you'll be ready to specialize and apply for permanent roles across the business, whether that's digital marketing, marketing technology, or analytics. You'll have built a well\-rounded skill set, from advanced Excel to our own approach to project management, and be well prepared to take on a role and thrive in it. At the core of this program is a commitment to growing our own future leaders, and we're fully invested in giving you the training and path to get there. title: 2K Games - Technical Art Graduate Program - Dublin
description: Founded in 2005, 2K Games is a global video game company, publishing titles developed by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Our studios responsible for developing 2K’s portfolio of world\-class games across multiple platforms, include Visual Concepts, Firaxis, Hangar 13, CatDaddy, Cloud Chamber, and HB Studios. Our portfolio of titles is expanding due to our global strategic plan, building, and acquiring exciting studios whose content continues to inspire all of us! 2K publishes titles in today’s most popular gaming genres, including sports, shooters, action, role\-playing, strategy, casual, and family entertainment. Our team of engineers, marketers, artists, writers, data scientists, producers, problem solvers, and doers, are the professional publishing stewards of our growing library of critically acclaimed franchises such as NBA 2K, Battleborn, BioShock, Borderlands, PGA TOUR 2K, Mafia, Sid Meier’s Civilization, WWE 2K, and XCOM. At 2K, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment, which means encouraging our teams to Come as You Are and do your best work! We are dedicated to diversity and inclusion and want our community of candidates to reflect this commitment. We encourage all qualified applicants to explore our global positions. What is Technical Art? Technical Artists make the art team more capable than it would be on its own. The art team is your customer, its problems set your priorities, and your work is judged on whether the artists it was built for actually use it. In practice that means building the tools artists use to create content, the rigs that make characters move, the shaders that give a world its look, the rules that scatter a landscape with vegetation, and the pipelines that carry all of it into the game. Program overview 21 months, starting Summer 2027, based in Dublin. **Foundation Training. Eleven weeks.** You get a brief, a deadline, and the tools art teams use every day, and you work out how to deliver. You build across all four specializations, including the ones you are weakest in: Pipeline and Tools, Character and Animation, Rendering and Visuals, Environment and World. What you build is reviewed by people who do this for a living, and the review covers how you worked and how you talked to the people you built it for, not only what you delivered. Some of the work is yours alone and some is shared with the Engineering and Publishing graduates. Foundation Training runs on Unreal Engine, Maya, Python, and Perforce. The program assumes you arrive knowing one or two of them, not all four. **Three strategic rotations, six months each.** Rotations run across our studios, including Hangar 13, HB Studios, Visual Concepts, Firaxis, Small Axe, and Gearbox, and across the central technology teams that build the tools and pipelines every studio shares. Which team you rotate onto is decided around game timelines, and what the teams need at the time, and your own developing focus is part of that conversation. What we are looking for An outstanding portfolio is the first thing we look at, and it should show the work and how you got there. It does not have to be an art portfolio. Tools, scripts, rigs, shaders all count. If the work was made with other people, tell us which parts were yours. **There Are Two Things You Need** * Comfort in at least one content\-creation package or game engine. Maya, Blender, Houdini, Substance, Unreal Engine, or whatever you happened to learn. * Some scripting. It does not need to be much, but you should be able to read code and have written something. **Beyond That, The Qualities That Matter Most** * Curiosity. You want to know how things are made, and you dig in to find out. * Persistence. A lot of this job is being stuck: something is broken, the reason is not obvious, and you keep going until you find it. * Communication. You will spend more time talking and asking questions than most people expect. **Education.** Game Art, Animation, VFX, Technical Art, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. We also take people with any unrelated degree who have a portfolio that shows the work. What you have made matters more to us than where you studied. The key is that you have a recent degree. **Experience.** No games industry experience is needed. This is a graduate program, and it is built for people who have never worked in games. Mod work, game jams, university projects, and freelance work are all relevant experiences as far as we are concerned. **Recent graduates.** Eligible Grads from January 2025 to June 2027 are eligible to apply. Exceptions may be made on a case\-by\-case basis if your grad date falls outside of these dates. Technical Art is a job people arrive at from many directions, so apply even if you do not match every line above. How to apply Send a CV/resume and a portfolio. The portfolio can be an ArtStation page, a personal site, a GitHub profile, an itch.io page, a reel, or a PDF. Which platform it lives on matters much less than whether we can open it and follow what we are looking at. If your work is spread across several places, link all of them and tell us which one to start with. If your resume doesn't explicitly have Tech Art, you're welcome to create a cover letter for us to review telling us why you're interested in this program. Cover letters are entirely optional. title: AI Engineer
description: **Junior AI Engineer** **Job Description** My client, a professional services organisation, is seeking a Junior AI Engineer to join a growing technology and automation function, supporting the development of AI\-enabled applications, integrations and intelligent workflow solutions. **Job Responsibilities** * Design, develop, test and support internal AI\-powered tools and workflow automations that improve business processes and reduce manual activity. * Build and maintain APIs and integrations that enable AI models to interact securely with enterprise applications, data sources and business systems. * Develop production\-quality solutions using technologies such as Python and Rust, with exposure to TypeScript and Node.js where appropriate. * Support the development of AI agent workflows, including prompt design, tool use, orchestration, evaluation and appropriate technical safeguards. * Work with Microsoft technologies including Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power Platform, Dataverse and Microsoft Graph to develop integrated automation solutions. * Use Git and GitHub for source control, branching, pull requests, code reviews, CI/CD processes and general development collaboration. * Produce clear technical documentation, including architecture notes, support documentation, implementation guidance and operational procedures. * Engage with technical and non\-technical stakeholders to understand requirements, demonstrate solutions and refine applications based on user feedback. **Experience Required** * 1\-3 years’ professional experience in software engineering, AI engineering, automation or a related technical area, with strong graduate, academic, personal or open\-source projects also considered. * Practical experience developing solutions using generative AI models and associated APIs rather than solely using consumer chat interfaces. * Good understanding of AI concepts including prompting, context management, function or tool calling and the limitations of large language models. * Working knowledge of Rust, ideally demonstrated through an academic, personal or open\-source project, together with an understanding of concepts such as ownership, error handling and dependency management. * Strong Python fundamentals and familiarity with modern Python project, environment and dependency management tools. * Experience building or consuming REST APIs, including working with JSON, authentication mechanisms, error handling and API documentation. * Good understanding of core software engineering practices including testing, debugging, maintainable code and version control. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to colleagues from non\-technical backgrounds. **Desirable Skills** * Exposure to Model Context Protocol (MCP), AI agents or frameworks supporting multi\-step tool use and workflow orchestration. * Knowledge of Microsoft technologies such as Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI, Dataverse, SharePoint Online, Microsoft Graph or Microsoft Copilot. * TypeScript and Node.js development experience. * Understanding of SQL, document processing, vector databases, semantic search or Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG). * Exposure to Azure services such as Functions, App Service, Key Vault or Storage. * Familiarity with Docker, cloud deployment practices and CI/CD pipelines. * Experience evaluating AI applications, including logging, tracing, output quality measurement, reliability and cost monitoring. * Awareness of data protection, confidentiality, responsible AI and regulatory considerations when developing AI\-enabled systems. * Understanding of secure software development practices including secrets management, least\-privilege access, prompt\-injection risks and prevention of unintended data exposure. * Experience with workflow automation or low\-code platforms would be beneficial. **Educational Requirements** * Third\-level degree or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence or another related discipline. * Candidates with a strong demonstrable portfolio of equivalent technical work may also be considered. **Working Hours \& Benefits** * Permanent position with standard Monday\-to\-Friday working hours. * Opportunity to join a developing AI and automation capability at an early stage. * Broad exposure to AI engineering, software development, APIs, cloud technologies and enterprise automation. * Opportunity to work directly with experienced technology leadership and contribute to engineering standards and ways of working. * Continued professional development in a rapidly evolving area of technology. * Exposure to a range of modern AI models, platforms and development tools. **How to Apply** To apply for this role, please submit your updated CV. If your skills and experience match job requirements, you will be contacted to discuss your application in detail. **Similar Roles Open** As a specialised recruitment agency, we also have several other permanent and contract IT roles available. Visit our website for more information or explore additional opportunities.

title: Accommodation Assistant
description: Start your career at Dalata Hotel Group! We are looking for team members to join us on an exciting journey. title: Accounts Assistant
description: **ABOUT US** Coastline Gaming is one of Ireland's most established gaming and entertainment operators — eleven venues across Ireland and Northern Ireland, plus a fast\-growing online casino. We've been at this for over forty years; we're still growing, and we invest in the people who grow with us. One thing to note up front: we're an AI\-forward company. Everyone here, from every department up to Director level, uses AI tools daily for real work — and we're serious about becoming more AI\-driven, not less. You'll get a professional AI stack from day one and the training to use it properly, whatever your role. **ABOUT THE ACCOUNTS ASSISTANT ROLE** This is a role for someone who wants to be at the centre of an accounts function, not on the edge of one. We're a small finance team supporting a large business, which means you won't have one lane. You'll work across the whole function: payables, receivables, reconciliations, payroll, VAT and reporting, often in the same week, sometimes in the same day. The work matters immediately. Payroll, payments and reporting are the heartbeat of this role, and you'll be involved in them early, with proper handover and support while you find your feet. No six months of shadowing before you touch anything real, but no one throwing you in at the deep end either. You'll report to the Financial Controller, with genuine room to shape how things are done. If you spot a process that's slower or messier than it should be, improving it is part of the job, and you'll have the tools to actually do it. We'd prefer this role to be based in Buncrana, but we're open to candidates in Dublin too, so if the rest of this fits, don't rule yourself out on location. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** * Processing supplier invoices, matching them to purchase orders and delivery dockets, running payment runs, raising sales and inter\-company invoices, and using AI tools to cut down the repetitive work * Reconciling multiple bank accounts and payment gateway statements, using AI to speed up the matching and flag anomalies, then following up on discrepancies until they are properly resolved * Preparing and processing payroll including PAYE, PRSI and USC, managing starters and leavers, and filing accurate VAT returns ahead of every Revenue deadline * Producing the weekly and monthly management reports the business actually uses, supporting month\-end close, and using AI to analyse costs, spot trends and surface savings faster than a spreadsheet alone would * Looking for processes that could be quicker, cleaner or automated altogether, and having the tools and the mandate to change them **WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** *We care more about how you think than what's on your CV. If you meet most of this and the role interests you, we'd encourage you to apply.* * You've worked directly on payables, receivables or reconciliations, ideally with exposure to accounting software and payroll * You already use tools like ChatGPT or Claude for actual work and want to go further. You don't need to be technical; you need genuine interest and something to show for it * AI speeds up work, but it doesn't excuse sloppy numbers. Multiple deadlines, multiple priorities, and you still hit them * You see what needs doing and do it, and you can look at a finance process and say what's working, what isn't, and why * A relevant qualification, part\-qualified ACCA/ACA, is an advantage, but not essential. **THE DETAILS** **Location:** Dublin or Buncrana, Co. Donegal **Working model:** Fully office\-based in Buncrana, or hybrid for Dublin\-based team members

title: Chief Medical Scientist
description: **CHIEF MEDICAL SCIENTIST (MICROBIOLOGY)** **Reporting To:** Administratively – Laboratory Manager Clinically – Consultant Microbiologist **Job Summary:** To participate in planning, co\-ordinating and promoting all activities within the relevant department ensuring the achievement of agreed targets and standards. The fundamental philosophy guiding this position is to promote and preserve the Bon Secours Mission, Values and Ethos. **Duties and Responsibilities** Under the general direction and control of the Laboratory Manager and the Consultant Microbiologist, the Chief Medical Scientist will be responsible for the following: **General:** * Be responsible for the daily operation and performance of the microbiology service, ensuring internal and external measures of quality are in place. * Provide strategic and clinical leadership, which results in the delivery of effective, efficient, quality assured and patient centred laboratory service. * In collaboration with pathology and hospital management, develop a vision for the service and deliver that vision through strategic planning and project management * Develop a shared sense of commitment and participation among staff in the development of the microbiology service. * Ensure open channels of communication between Senior Management and laboratory staff to promote an open and well\-informed workplace. * Collaborate with the Laboratory Manager, Consultants, other Department leads and Service users within a broader laboratory and hospital environment to ensure the service provided matches user requirements and supports the clinical needs of the patient. * Perform routine and specialised work to the highest professional standards. * Demonstrate professional behaviour consistent with the values of the Hospital. * Provide a working environment that stimulates and motivates staff and attracts and retains the best people. **Operations:** * Lead out on the implementation of new procedures, technologies and IT systems. * Advise on equipment selection, purchase, replacement or upgrading. * Participate in future development of the Laboratory Service that support the clinical needs of the patients and are consistent with the mission, vision, values, and strategic plan of the wider Hospital. * Explore new and innovative methodologies to continually improve and modernise the microbiology service. * Make necessary preparations to foresee service failures and plan contingency measures accordingly (such as those required by surges in service demand, power outages, problems with the computer systems, analyser downtime, implementing the Major Emergency Plan etc.) * In collaboration with the Laboratory Manager, identify and implement operational processes in microbiology to the standards of ‘best practice’, optimising the most efficient and effective use of resources. * Identify and communicate resource requirements in the event of altered service demand. * Support, promote and actively participate in sustainable energy, water, and waste initiatives to create a more sustainable, low carbon and efficient health service. * To maintain an asset register of all equipment in the Laboratory, ensure regular preventative maintenance is carried out, hold documentation as appropriate on external maintenance contracts and liaise with equipment manufacturers on maintenance issues. * To take responsibility for monitoring, presenting and troubleshooting internal and external quality assurance procedures. * To ensure there are adequate processes of communication in the department with regard to any changes in policy, methods etc. * To participate in the writing of SOP’s and in any other duties required to secure and maintain Laboratory Accreditation. * To co\-ordinate the training of student medical scientists in addition to new scientific and medical staff as required. * To facilitate and encourage continued education and further training of staff as appropriate and support the career development of staff. * To represent the Laboratory at scientific and other meetings within and outside the hospital as required. * To perform such other duties appropriate to the office as may be assigned to him/her by Laboratory Manager and/or Consultant Microbiologist. **Quality Assurance and Risk Management:** * Oversee the delivery of a high\-quality service to the patient aligned to and compliant with all applicable standards and statutes, including ISO15189\. * To perform tasks and duties in a manner that ensures compliance with relevant regulations so that the requirements of International standard ISO 15189 (current version), JCI accreditation standards for hospitals, and relevant Medical Devices Directives 93/42/EC and 98/79/EC are met. * Have a working knowledge of the relevant INAB, JCI and Health Information and Quality Authority (HIQA) Standards as they apply to the role for example, Standards for Healthcare, National Standards for the Prevention and Control of Healthcare Associated Infections, Hygiene Standards etc and comply with associated hospital protocols for implementing and maintaining these standards as appropriate to the role * In collaboration with the Pathology Quality Manager, ensure compliance with all aspects of the quality management system and ISO:15189 including, but not limited to document control, audit, management of non\-conformances, management of risk and clinical risk in line with ISO 15189:2022\. * Ensure compliance with S.I. (Statutory Instrument) No. 360 of 2005 European Communities, ISO 15189 and IVDR. * Adequately identify, assess, manage and monitor risk within area of responsibility. * Handle feedback relating to the service as required, including responding appropriately to advisory notices from regulatory authorities. * Assume responsibility for the quality of work in the microbiology department and carry out all duties in accordance with Hospital policy and accreditation standards. * Achieve compliance with all legislation and EU Directives on Laboratory Quality and Safety and in conformance with the Hospital’s and Laboratory’s quality and safety policies and procedures. * Observe the strictest confidence, in line with BSHS GDPR policy, when dealing with all aspects of patient or Hospital information. * Participate in Laboratory, Hospital and/or external committees as required. * Develop, update, and review policies, procedures and guidelines for the department and be an active participant in formulating and carrying out hospital policies and procedures. * Maintain a clear understanding of the importance of providing a quality and safe service to all patients. * To attend relevant meetings and to actively participate in formulation of policies, clinical guidelines, operational policy / procedures and the sharing of information. * To investigate all relevant complaints and provide a timely response in accordance with the Hospital protocol, policies and procedures. Take a leadership and management role in relation to all such issues. * Take an active role in the pursuit and maintenance of accreditation in conjunction with relevant Line Managers. **Safety, Health \& Welfare at Work** * Participate and cooperate with legislative and regulatory requirements in relation to Health and Safety as outlined in the Safety, Health and Welfare Act 2005 and the Hospital Safety Statement. * Provide a safe working environment that is compliant with relevant Health and Safety legislation and with the Hospital Safety Statement, where staff are empowered to deliver the required service to the best of their ability. * Maintain a safe environment for all staff in consultation with appropriate personnel and direct staff on procedures to be followed in an emergency or disaster situation. * Ensure that the management of safety, health and welfare is successfully integrated into all activities undertaken within their area of responsibility, so far as is reasonably practicable. * Participate in regular Health and Safety audits. **Education \& Training:** * Keep abreast of scientific and medical research, support research activities and participate fully in the development of the post. * Engage in and support development initiatives and research activities. * Participate in mandatory training programmes and other training as required to keep up to date with developments. * Lead out on multi\-disciplinary training strategies. * Facilitate arrangements for training of under\-graduates and post\-graduates as required. * Provide supervision and guidance to all grades as required (e.g., clerical, domestic, support) * Take responsibility for and keep up to date with current practice by participating in continuing professional development\*. * Encourage and promote professional development of staff, through self\-learning, formal courses, or formal and/or informal on the job training within the Hospital procedures. * Maintain up\-to\-date personal training / retraining records in accordance with laboratory policy. **Financial \& Administrative** * Be accountable for the delivery of a high quality, cost\-effective service, working within approved pay and non\-pay budgets. * Ensure that financial, human and IT resources are deployed appropriately and utilised effectively to support the clinical service to the patients. * Adhere to best practice in the management of stock, procurement of equipment, audit and stocktake, and all matters pertaining to the National Financial Regulations * Represent the Department in meetings, reports, scientific papers, presentations, negotiations, etc. as required and provide data in response to requests. * Provide statistical and management information as requested. * To assist the Laboratory manager and the Hospital Manager in implementing any corrective programme necessary for adherence to financial budgets. * To utilise financial and other information to plan and deliver agreed levels of service. **Human Resource Management** The post holder is responsible, through appropriate line management delegation, for the supervision and development of staff to motivate and maximise their performance potential. Such delegated duties will ensure that: * Staff attendances are optimised in relation to work schedules. * All annual, examination, parental and other leave is scheduled and recorded. * Hospital HR policies are complied with. * Appropriate induction training of new staff * Hospital Health and Safety Regulations are complied with. * Staff review and development is carried out for all staff. * Participate as appropriate in the recruitment and selection process of staff. * Develop, implement and foster a high level of moral amongst staff by effective motivation and communication. * Develop and promote, in conjunction with the HR Department and Line Managers an appropriate training programmes for staff that is consistent with hospital policy and encourages skill mix. * To ensure that annual leave and study leave of all Microbiology staff are cost effectively scheduled to always ensure the availability of cover. * In collaboration with other disciplines, promote good industrial relations **ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS** Candidates for appointment must Possess: * Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Medical Science from the Galway/Mayo Institute of Technology (GMIT). Or * Bachelor of Science (Honours) Biomedical Science, Dublin Institute of Technology (DIT). Or * Bachelor in Science Honours degree in Biomedical Science from the Joint University College Cork – Cork Institute of Technology course AND Diploma in Clinical Laboratory Practice. Or * Certificate in Medical Laboratory Science, Dublin Institute of Technology (DIT), Cork Institute of Technology (CIT) or Galway/Mayo Institute of Technology (GMIT) AND Bachelor in Science (Applied Science) Honours degree (Biomedical option) from the University of Dublin/Dublin Institute of Technology (Awarded prior to 2002\). Or * Bachelor of Biomedical Science, Cork Institute of Technology (CIT) AND BSc (Honours) Biomedical Sciences, University College Cork (UCC). (Awarded prior to 2013\). Or * Diploma in Medical Laboratory Sciences of the Dublin Institute of Technology, (DIT) or the Cork Institute of Technology (CIT) (Awarded prior to 1994\). Or * Certificate in Medical Laboratory Science awarded before 1997 by Dublin Institute of Technology (DIT), Cork Institute of Technology (CIT) or Galway/Mayo Institute of Technology (GMIT). Or * An equivalent qualification validated by the Academy of Clinical Science and Laboratory Medicine (ACSLM). ***And*** Possess one of the following NFQ Level 9 post graduate qualifications or equivalent qualification at minimum Level 9 validated by the Academy of Clinical Science and Laboratory Medicine; * MSc Clinical Laboratory Science, Dublin Institute of Technology. * MSc MicrobiologyMicrobiology, University of Dublin, Trinity College. * MSc Biomedical Science, University of Ulster. * MSc Biomedical Science, Cork Institute of Technology / University College Cork. * MSc Molecular Pathology, Dublin Institute of Technology / University of Dublin, Trinity College. Or * Have attained the Fellowship examination of the Institute of Biomedical Science (Awarded prior to 1999\). And * Possess seven years full time clinical experience (or an aggregate of seven years’ clinical experience) as a medical scientist in a clinical diagnostic laboratory since qualifying as a medical scientist. , two of which were spent in a promotional post. * Demonstrate evidence of Continuous Professional Development. * Must be registered with CORU or eligible for membership upon completion of study or in the process of applying for state registration, see https://www.coru.ie/about\-us/registration\-boards/medicalscientists\-registration\-board/apply\-for\-registration/ **ESSENTIAL EXPERIENCE** * Minimum 7\-years post–graduate experience in a Pathology Laboratory, 2 of which must have been spent in a promotional grade. * Knowledge and experience of working in an ISO15189 accredited Medical Laboratory. **DESIRABLE EXPERIENCE** * Experience of working with iLab Laboratory Information System CLOSING DATE FOR RECEIPT OF APPLICATIONS 5TH OCTOBER 2026 *Bon Secours Health System is an equal opportunities employer. title: Clinical Pharmacist
description: **Pharmacist roles available in TCP Homecare \- Excellent work life balance and full training provided.** **Specified purpose contract (anticipated to be 12 \- 14 months), full time, desk based, office role, no weekends/late nights** Pharmacist required Monday to Friday in Dublin 12 to join the pharmacist team. No late nights, no on\-call and no rostered weekend work (8 to 5/9 to 6\). Lunch break. Full training is provided. **No experience in homecare necessary \- role may suit new graduate.** The pharmacist position is desk based, with a rotation on checking in the fridge and dispensary in the afternoons. This role will appeal to pharmacists wishing to support patients in the home, learn about rare drugs and bespoke services, and maintain a positive work life balance. The role is based in our licensed pharmacy in Clondalkin, Dublin 12, near the red cow roundabout. * Monday to Friday * Finish by 6pm * Professional fees paid * Protected time for training/learning * Pension/Health insurance contribution after 6 months * Staff discount scheme TCP Homecare are a leading provider of Homecare Services on a national scale specialising in supporting patients in their own home, moving away from hospital based care. You will be part of a professional, quality focused team, who continually strive to provide the highest clinical care to patients. Support the RP in the maintenance of the Quality Management System. * Participate in clinical trials, in accordance with the standards of Good Clinical Practice. Responsibility for drug accountability and completion of dispensing logs and clinical trial documentation. * Collaborate with the procurement officer to oversee the ordering of rare and orphan drugs. * Maintain professional competency and keep up to date with current developments in current area of practice. * Adhere to the guidelines, laws, code of conduct and policies of the Pharmaceutical Society of Ireland.

Our clients range from growth\-focused entrepreneurial businesses through to leading multi\-national organisations across many sectors and operating nationally and across borders. **About the role** RSM has a new and exciting opportunity for a graduate or postgraduate who is interested in building a career in company secretarial practice, corporate governance and compliance. Registers. * Assist with incoming post for registered office clients. * Assist with the maintenance of the annual compliance diary to ensure client filings are progressed in a timely manner. * Liaise interest in completing a Corporate Governance programme or an equivalent governance qualification. * Hold a third\-level degree, ideally in business, law, accounting, governance, management or a related discipline * Have a genuine interest in corporate governance, company law, compliance, board effectiveness and how well\-governed organisations operate. * Be organised, professional and able to manage competing deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy. * Possess strong written and verbal communication skills, with confidence dealing with clients, colleagues and external advisers. * Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Word, Excel and Outlook. * Excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach to managing deadlines and administrative tasks. * Ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative team. * Discretion and professionalism when handling confidential client information. ***\#RSM is an equal opportunity employer***

description: An exciting opportunity to join Ireland's leading independent manufacturer of concrete and bituminous construction materials. title: Consulting Graduate Programme 2027

As part of our team, you'll learn from the best, gain hands\-on experience across a range of industries, and be part of a community that values collaboration, curiosity, and creativity. **Why choose Crowe Ireland?** At Crowe Ireland, we are a close\-knit team with a global reach. Our firm is all about fostering talent, encouraging fresh ideas, and driving positive change for our clients and community. We are big enough to offer great opportunities, international assignments and write a successful story and small enough for you to make great impacts on some of our projects from the word go. Join us, and you will be part of a dynamic and diverse team that values growth, learning and having a bit of fun along the way! **What’s in it for You?** Our 2027 Consulting Graduate Programme is your gateway to an exciting career in consulting with a focus on becoming a qualified accountant. You will work on diverse projects that help shape the future of businesses, not\-for\-profit and public organizations. You’ll be involved in everything from risk management and internal audits to strategic planning and change management, developing the skills you need to thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment. Our Consulting Graduate Programme is designed to give you real\-world experience, professional development, and a fast track to becoming a qualified accountant. You’ll get to work with amazing clients, use trending technology, and learn from a team that genuinely cares about your success. **Here’s what you’ll do:** Your Role: 1. Dive into Diverse Projects: Work on a variety of consulting assignments across different sectors—no two days are the same! 2. Data Detective: Use the latest tools and techniques to analyse client data, spot trends, and uncover insights that drive smart decisions. 3. Business Insights: Learn how businesses operate, identify areas for improvement, and build relationships with clients that go beyond the numbers. 4. Impactful Reporting: Draft high\-quality consulting reports, packed with practical recommendations to help clients strengthen their operations. 5. Team Collaboration: Work with colleagues across different disciplines—like tax, corporate finance, and company secretarial—to deliver seamless consulting services. 6. Communication Pro: Keep the Partner in the loop, flagging significant issues and progress on your assignments while collaborating with partners, directors, and other managers to deliver top\-notch services. 7. Quality and Compliance: Deliver work that meets the highest standards, addressing key risks and sticking to deadlines and budgets. **How we are going to support your development** : * Crowe will fully sponsor your accounting qualification: You will have the freedom to choose which accounting qualification you will pursue. film, and appear in platform\-native UGC\-style content across a range of consumer brands * Edit short\-form video and UGC footage for Meta, TikTok, and other relevant paid channels using CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar tools * Create product demonstrations, testimonials, problem\-and\-solution concepts, unboxings, lifestyle content, and other direct\-response formats * Write and output Creator Partnerships * Source and assess creators based on campaign audience, category, location, creative style, and production requirements * Support creator outreach, briefing, ownership of assigned work while communicating clearly about progress, deadlines, and production needs What You'll Bring * A portfolio demonstrating strong visual judgment through UGC, short\-form video, social content, graphic design, photography, or related creative work * Experience creating content for Meta, TikTok, Reels, or other short\-form platforms * Working knowledge of Canva and at least one video\-editing platform such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar * Confidence and a natural presence on camera, with the ability to adapt your delivery to different brands and audiences * Strong visual storytelling instincts and an eye for composition, pacing, typography, hierarchy, and mobile\-first creative * Practical knowledge of lighting, framing, audio, and short\-form video production * Ability to follow a creative brief, apply feedback carefully, and manage multiple deadlines * Strong organization, communication, and file\-management habits * Curiosity about advertising, audience behavior, creative testing, and what makes paid\-social content perform * Experience with AI creative tools for ideation, visual development, editing, or content iteration * A collaborative, dependable approach and comfort working in a fast\-moving creative environment Nice to Have * Experience sourcing or managing creators, influencers, or freelance production partners * Experience working with brand guidelines or across multiple visual identities * Familiarity with Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma, motion graphics, or additional design tools * Experience reviewing creative performance data and using insights to develop new iterations * Access to varied shooting environments or retail locations that can support different types of UGC production Portfolio Required A portfolio is required to be considered for this position. title: Field Sales Developer (Dublin & North Leinster)
description: Here at innocent, we’re on a mission to make it easier for everyone to get more fruit and veg into their bodies. We started back in 1999 and since then we’ve gone from selling a few smoothies at a music festival to becoming one of Europe’s biggest drinks companies with around 1,000 people (and the B Corp seal of approval). It’s nice to be able to say things like that but we’re not patting ourselves on the back just yet. We want to show everyone that it’s possible to be a successful business while looking after people and the planet too, so we’re trying to get better in pretty much every way. And that’s where this job comes in. **What You'll Be Doing** In this role, you’ll report to our Field Sales Manager. You’ll be winning new business by influencing our key food service and convenience accounts in an innocent way in Dublin \& North Leinster, while building long lasting relationships with our customers. We want you to help us sell as many drinks as we planned to (and a few more) by finding new customers and securing additional distribution in existing customers. You’ll be required to ensure promotions are implemented at store level and that we always look our best where our products are on sale. It’ll be a real chance to make a difference to our business working together with the people here at Fruit Towers in Dublin as well as our food service and convenience sector partners. **You'll Have** * Motivation \- things move fast at innocent so you’ll need to be able to pick things up pretty quickly * A passion for selling \- you’ll love working with people * You’ll have to make sure innocent always looks great at the point of purchase * the ability to communicate well and build relationships with customers * To be a quick learner, you’ll have bags of initiative and be pro\-active at getting things done * be comfortable dealing with numbers * have a full valid driver’s licence as you’ll spend most of your time on the road visiting customers **you'll get:** * an exposure to an entrepreneurial fast growing company * an exciting and challenging role that is different every day * loads of opportunities to hone your selling, negotiating \& presentation skills * the ability to make a tangible difference to the success of innocent * an opportunity to get to know some of our most valued retailers We want innocent to be a great place to work, so we do lots of stuff to make people feel at home and try to make sure everyone’s career is shaping up the way they want it to. There are plenty of opportunities to have a go at something new or take things further. In exchange for helping us do business in the right way, you’ll get a solid rewards package that includes a salary (phew), private healthcare, a target\-based bonus, and a bunch of other nice things like a day off on your birthday. And yes, you get free smoothies. We also know that not all our drinkers come from the same background, or think the same – so why should we? At innocent, we want to be a great place to work where a diverse bunch of people from all backgrounds can turn up and thrive. When we hire, we want all the juice, bits, and pulp that make you who you are. Even if you don’t think you can tick all the boxes, if the job sounds right for you, come and throw your hat in the ring. Probably best to get your skates on though, as we might close this early if we get loads of applications.

title: Geoenvironmental Work Placement
description: Ground Engineering Europe Region  DUB0000X2 Requisition \# Geoenvironmental Work Placement See it differently \- Early Careers at Arup See it differently You see the world through a unique lens and that’s exactly what we need. We embrace how you see things differently – it’s essential for creating a sustainable future. Arup is a global consultancy with advisory and technical expertise across more than 150 disciplines. We guide, plan and design the future of the built environment. Globally, each year we recruit hundreds of graduates and students who help us see things differently and solve the most complex challenges facing our clients, climate and communities. The Opportunity We are currently seeking a Work Placement geoenvironmental scientist/engineer to join our specialist Ground Engineering team in Cork or Dublin, Ireland. The team provides geological, geoenvironmental, hydrogeological and geotechnical input to a portfolio of exciting, varied and multidisciplinary projects across Ireland and internationally. Our work spans major infrastructure, energy, water, environmental and development projects, with a strong focus on understanding land and groundwater quality conditions and managing environmental risks During your work placement at Arup, you will work alongside a team on tasks such as: * Geological, geoenvironmental, hydrogeological and geotechnical desk studies, site assessments and development of conceptual site models. * Planning and interpretation of ground investigations, including drilling, trial pitting, rock coring, geological logging, and soil and water sampling. * Assessment and interpretation of geochemical data to determine impacts on land and water quality. * Review options for the sustainable use of soils and stone during construction projects * Groundwater contaminant transport modelling to assess to need for remediation or assessing the potential impacts of the re\-use of materials. * Preparation of technical reports, geoenvironmental assessments, and environmental documentation. * Geoenvironmental input to Environmental Impact Assessment Reports (EIARs), and regulatory submissions. * Working closely with specialists from other disciplines to develop integrated and sustainable engineering solutions. * Attending project meetings and communicating with colleagues, project partners, contractors, regulators and clients. Is this role right for you? We're looking for students who are working towards an undergraduate or masters degree in Geoscience / Earth Science, Hydrogeology, Environmental Science / Engineering (which include geology) or similar. Alongside your degree, we look for the following core attributes; * Changemakers: A passion for sustainable development and creating a better world is key. * Innovative minds: We’re looking for critical thinkers who embrace new ideas and challenge the status quo. * Growth seekers: You have a growth mindset, always eager to learn and explore new ways of working. * Adaptable adventurers: You’re ready to take on any challenge that comes your way. Please note, in the event of high applicant volume, this role may be closed ahead of the advertised closing date. Early application is recommended. What we offer you At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together. Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do. We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling permanent members to share in the results of our collective efforts. We take an approach to flexible working that supports the diversity and wellbeing of our graduates. Different people, shared values Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas \- this drives our excellence. Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross\-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ\+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your\-life\-at\-arup. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas. Candidates have the opportunity to disclose any disability or learning difference they may have on their application form. We will then make any appropriate arrangements for you should you reach a further stage in our recruitment process. The information gathered during the recruitment process is only used to allow for adjustments to be made for the interview and is not considered in any other context of your application. \#IRELAND\_INTERNS

The intern will work closely with the Network Planning Team to analyse existing charging networks, identify opportunities for expansion, and contribute to data\-driven planning decisions. **Key Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. By researching account\-specific context and industry trends, you will craft multi\-channel campaigns (cold calling, personalised email, and targeted content) that map Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform directly to customer business strategies. title: Graduate - Design Verification Engineer
description: **ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.** At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. Whether you’re designing next\-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career. **Graduate \- Design Verification Engineer** **The Role** As a Silicon Design Engineer, you will work closely with verification experts and designers to verify a variety of DDR Subsystems that incorporates multiple DDR/LPDDR controllers, PHYs, clock IPs and other compenents. This will be leveraging UVM and also Formal proofs. This role is a lauch pad into executing roles that will give plenty of scope for career progression and personal development in the future. The first role is the key role to be able to learn alongside local experts and evolve as an engineer. **The Person** You have a passion for compelx digital design, and verification in general. You work on evolving as a team player with excellent communication skills. You have strong analytical and problem\-solving skills and are willing to learn and are ready to take on problems. **Key Responsibilities** * Drive verification for a design as well as write formal properties and assertions to verify designs * Coordinate with RTL engineers to implement logic design for better clock gating and verify all the various aspects of the design * Write tests, sequences, and testbench components in SystemVerilog and UVM along with Formal to achieve the complete verification of the design * Responsible for verification quality metrics like pass rates, code coverage and functional coverage **Preferred Experience** * Project level experience with design concepts and RTL implementation or verification during an earlier internship * Experience or familiarity with Formal tools or Functional verification tools like VCS * Having crafted designs or testbenches in Verilog or System\-Verilog **Academic Credentials** * Bachelors or Masters degree in Electronics/Computer/Electrical Engineering * A track record in univierity of consistent high grades especially with subject specialization and project work *Benefits offered are described:* AMD benefits at a glance. *AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee\-based recruitment services. AMD and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity, inclusive employers and will consider all applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third\-party affiliation, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants’ needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process.* *AMD may use Artificial Intelligence to help screen, assess or select applicants for this position. AMD’s “Responsible AI Policy” is available here.* *This posting is for an existing vacancy.*

title: Graduate AI Automation Engineer
description: Byrne Wallace Shields is building out its internal AI automation capability, and we're looking for a graduate engineer to help us do it. Working directly with our Head of Digital Automation with AI, you'll design, build and support the tools, integrations and agent workflows that automate how the firm runs — connecting AI models such as Claude and ChatGPT to our Microsoft 365 estate, building the APIs and MCP servers that let those models work safely with firm data, and helping shape the engineering practices a growing AI function needs. It's a hands\-on role and a genuine chance to help build a new function from the ground up, with broad exposure across the full stack of AI automation work. **What you'll be doing** * Build, test and maintain internal tools and automations that use large language models (Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to take manual effort out of firm processes. * Design and develop APIs and integrations — including MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers — connecting AI models to systems such as SharePoint, Dataverse and Microsoft Graph securely and auditably. * Write clean, well\-tested code in Rust and Python (with UV), and TypeScript/Node where it fits; work in GitHub day to day — branching, pull requests, code review and Actions CI/CD. * Contribute to prompt design, agent orchestration and evaluation, measuring whether a workflow is accurate, reliable and safe enough to put in front of fee\-earners. * Support Power Platform solutions (Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse) where they fit, document what you build, and work with legal and business services teams to gather requirements and demo solutions. * Apply the firm's AI governance, data protection and information security requirements throughout, and stay current with a fast\-moving field. **What we're looking for** * **AI tooling:** practical, hands\-on experience with Claude and ChatGPT — their APIs and developer tooling (e.g. Claude Code or the OpenAI SDKs), not just the chat interfaces; you understand prompting, tool use, context management and model limits. * **GitHub:** confident with Git and GitHub (branching, pull requests, code review, Actions); you can point us at repositories you've contributed to. * **Rust \& Python:** working knowledge of Rust with at least one non\-trivial project you can walk us through; solid Python fundamentals with UV. * **APIs:** designing, building and consuming REST APIs — auth (OAuth 2\.0 / bearer tokens), JSON, error handling, rate limiting. * **Fundamentals:** you write tests and readable code, debug methodically, explain technical work to non\-technical colleagues, and write documentation people actually read. * **A degree (or equivalent)** in computer science, software engineering, data science or a related discipline — or a demonstrable portfolio of equivalent work. Curious, self\-directed, and serious about quality and confidentiality.

title: Graduate AI Engineer
description: **Junior AI Engineer** **Job Description** My client, a professional services organisation, is seeking a Junior AI Engineer to join a growing technology and automation function, supporting the development of AI\-enabled applications, integrations and intelligent workflow solutions. **Job Responsibilities** * Design, develop, test and support internal AI\-powered tools and workflow automations that improve business processes and reduce manual activity. * Build and maintain APIs and integrations that enable AI models to interact securely with enterprise applications, data sources and business systems. * Develop production\-quality solutions using technologies such as Python and Rust, with exposure to TypeScript and Node.js where appropriate. * Support the development of AI agent workflows, including prompt design, tool use, orchestration, evaluation and appropriate technical safeguards. * Work with Microsoft technologies including Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power Platform, Dataverse and Microsoft Graph to develop integrated automation solutions. * Use Git and GitHub for source control, branching, pull requests, code reviews, CI/CD processes and general development collaboration. * Produce clear technical documentation, including architecture notes, support documentation, implementation guidance and operational procedures. * Engage with technical and non\-technical stakeholders to understand requirements, demonstrate solutions and refine applications based on user feedback. **Experience Required** * 1\-3 years’ professional experience in software engineering, AI engineering, automation or a related technical area, with strong graduate, academic, personal or open\-source projects also considered. * Practical experience developing solutions using generative AI models and associated APIs rather than solely using consumer chat interfaces. * Good understanding of AI concepts including prompting, context management, function or tool calling and the limitations of large language models. * Working knowledge of Rust, ideally demonstrated through an academic, personal or open\-source project, together with an understanding of concepts such as ownership, error handling and dependency management. * Strong Python fundamentals and familiarity with modern Python project, environment and dependency management tools. * Experience building or consuming REST APIs, including working with JSON, authentication mechanisms, error handling and API documentation. * Good understanding of core software engineering practices including testing, debugging, maintainable code and version control. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to colleagues from non\-technical backgrounds. **Desirable Skills** * Exposure to Model Context Protocol (MCP), AI agents or frameworks supporting multi\-step tool use and workflow orchestration. * Knowledge of Microsoft technologies such as Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI, Dataverse, SharePoint Online, Microsoft Graph or Microsoft Copilot. * TypeScript and Node.js development experience. * Understanding of SQL, document processing, vector databases, semantic search or Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG). * Exposure to Azure services such as Functions, App Service, Key Vault or Storage. * Familiarity with Docker, cloud deployment practices and CI/CD pipelines. * Experience evaluating AI applications, including logging, tracing, output quality measurement, reliability and cost monitoring. * Awareness of data protection, confidentiality, responsible AI and regulatory considerations when developing AI\-enabled systems. * Understanding of secure software development practices including secrets management, least\-privilege access, prompt\-injection risks and prevention of unintended data exposure. * Experience with workflow automation or low\-code platforms would be beneficial. **Educational Requirements** * Third\-level degree or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence or another related discipline. * Candidates with a strong demonstrable portfolio of equivalent technical work may also be considered. **Working Hours \& Benefits** * Permanent position with standard Monday\-to\-Friday working hours. * Opportunity to join a developing AI and automation capability at an early stage. * Broad exposure to AI engineering, software development, APIs, cloud technologies and enterprise automation. * Opportunity to work directly with experienced technology leadership and contribute to engineering standards and ways of working. * Continued professional development in a rapidly evolving area of technology. * Exposure to a range of modern AI models, platforms and development tools. **How to Apply** To apply for this role, please submit your updated CV. If your skills and experience match job requirements, you will be contacted to discuss your application in detail. **Similar Roles Open** As a specialised recruitment agency, we also have several other permanent and contract IT roles available. Visit our website for more information or explore additional opportunities.

title: Graduate Architect (Dublin)
description: At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission\-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting\-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good. Bring your passion, creativity and ambition — and together, we’ll create lasting change. title: Graduate Building Surveyor
