Our clients include investors, developers, landlords and occupiers across a wide range of sectors. As a Graduate Building Surveyor, you will work alongside experienced Chartered Building Surveyors and Project Managers, gaining exposure to a diverse range of commercial property projects while building the technical, professional and commercial skills required to achieve chartership. This is an exciting opportunity to join a collaborative and growing team where you will gain hands\-on experience across a broad range of surveying and project consultancy instructions, including: Building Surveying * Supporting technical due diligence surveys and reports * Assisting with condition surveys and building inspections * Helping prepare reinstatement cost assessments * Supporting planned preventative maintenance (PPM) programmes * Assisting in diagnosing building defects and identifying solutions * Exposure to conservation and heritage property projects Project \& Contract Management * Supporting Project Management and Contract Administration commissions * Assisting in the preparation of specifications and technical documentation * Monitoring project progress and construction quality * Coordinating with consultants, contractors and project teams * Exposure to refurbishment, fit\-out and development projects Client Advisory * Assisting in the preparation of reports and presentations for clients * Developing an understanding of landlord and tenant matters * Learning how to provide strategic advice on commercial property assets * Building strong client relationships through direct project involvement **What qualifications, attributes and characteristics define our Graduates?** * Relevant Building Surveying qualification * Eligible to pursue the APC * Commercial awareness and an interest in the Irish property market * Client\-focused with excellent relationship\-building skills * Strong planning and organisational skills * Numerate, adaptable and Through blended learning, mentoring, progress reviews and networking, you’ll build capability across four key areas: human skills, consulting skills, championing our strategy, and developing your personal passions. Here's what you'll need * Be working towards a relevant Degree or Master’s level qualification in Civil or Structural Engineering * A flexible, proactive mindset and motivation to drive your career forward * Adaptability and enthusiasm for learning * Permanent right to work in Ireland **Selection Process** * Apply Online * Solo Video Assessment * Interview Apply before **12 October 2026** to be considered in the first assessment window. Applications may still be accepted afterwards, but roles may be filled during the initial window. For further information, please see our brochure \- https://jacobs\-global.foleon.com/brochures/early\-careers/ \#EarlyCareersUK \#GraduateUK \#GraduateJob2027 \#GraduateCareersUK \#GraduaterecruitmentUK \#GraduateJobsUK \#GraduateopportunitiesUK Joining Jacobs not only connects you locally but globally. Our values stand on a foundation of safety, integrity, inclusion and belonging. We put people at the heart of our business, and we truly believe that by supporting one another through our culture of caring, we all succeed. We value positive mental health and a sense of belonging for all employees. With safety and flexibility always top of mind, we’ve gone beyond traditional ways of working so you have the support, means and space to maximize your potential. You’ll uncover flexible working arrangements, benefits, and opportunities, from well\-being benefits to our global giving and volunteering program, to exploring new and inventive ways to help our clients make the world a better place. No matter what drives you, you’ll discover how you can cultivate, nurture, and achieve your goals – all at a single global company. Find out more about life at Jacobs. We aim to embed inclusion and belonging in everything we do. We know that if we are inclusive, we’re more connected and creative. We accept people for who they are, and we champion the richness of different perspectives, lived experiences and backgrounds in the workplace, as a source of learning and innovation. title: Graduate Civil Engineer – Highways & Infrastructure – Dublin (2027 Start)
description: **Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.** At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations. There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world. We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us. **Job Description** We have an exciting opportunity in Dublin, Ireland, for a Graduate Civil Engineer to join our Highways, Active Travel and Infrastructure team of more than 150\+staff. AECOM are recognised as market leaders in highways, public transport and active travel. The team continues to deliver high\-profile and impactful projects across the island of Ireland. Based in our growing Dublin team, you’ll work within a positive and collaborative environment alongside experienced engineers and a locally based senior management team. You’ll also be enrolled in the AECOM ADVANCE Graduate Development Programme, designed to support your professional and personal development as you build your career with AECOM. **Why AECOM in Ireland?** As a graduate, you’ll support the delivery of a diverse range of high\-profile projects across the transportation sector, working with both local and national clients across Ireland. You’ll work as part of a multidisciplinary team, gaining hands\-on experience with industry\-leading tools and contributing to projects at all stages, from early feasibility and planning through to detailed design, construction support and contract administration. You’ll have the opportunity to contribute to projects including an extensive greenway programme for Transport Infrastructure Ireland (TII) and Local Authorities, active travel and public transport schemes, technical advisory work, and major infrastructure projects such as: * **Roads:** Major road schemes including the N25 Midleton to Youghal Transport Project (Co. Cork), N2 Rath to Kilmoon (Co. Meath), N3 M50 to Clonee, N4 Mullingar to Longford (Co. Westmeath and Co. Longford), N17 Milltown to Gortnagunned (Co. Galway), M21 Adare Bypass (Co. Limerick), M21 Adare to Attyflin, Carlow Southern Relief Road \& Multi Modal Corridor (Co. Carlow), N54 Tullybryan Realignment (Co. Monaghan), A24 Ballynahinch Bypass (Co. Down), and Newry Southern Relief Road (Co. Down). * **Public Transport:** Delivery teams for the TII Luas Programme, the NTA BusConnects Programmes, NTA Bus Stop Design Team, multiple major Irish rail projects, and the Metrolink. * **Greenways:** A vast programme of Greenways (\>300km) in the Republic of Ireland for TII and Local Authorities, including major greenway schemes like Barnesmore Gap Greenway and Carrigans to Lifford Greenway in County Donegal, the West Cork Greenways – Skibbereen Sections, and the Galway\-Oughterard Greenway. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Civil Engineering or similar. International applicants will hold an equivalent Degree recognised by the International Engineering Alliance (from a signatory of the Washington Accord). * Relevant modules, coursework or experience in highways, infrastructure or transportation would be an advantage * Enthusiastic, hard\-working and technically proficient, with ambition and drive * Good report writing and technical communication skills would be beneficial * Ability to structure and prioritise work effectively through close cooperation with the wider team * Ability to work effectively both as part of a team and independently, while demonstrating initiative and focus * Good communication skills, with the ability to present technical information clearly to colleagues, clients and other stakeholders * Willingness to develop professionally and work towards relevant professional accreditation or chartership **Additional Information** * Applicants are encouraged to apply as early as possible since CVs will be reviewed, and candidates selected for an advanced offer start. * Please include a covering letter with your application and provide all predicted and/or obtained academic grades. * You must have permanent right to work in the Republic of Ireland as we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position. At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.*** **About AECOM** AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public\- and private\-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm and its Professional Services business had revenue of $16\.1 billion in fiscal year 2025\. See how we are delivering sustainable legacies for generations to come at aecom.com and @AECOM. **Freedom to Grow in a World of Opportunity** You will have the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you’re working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed. You will help us foster a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients. AECOM provides a wide array of compensation, benefits and well\-being programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too. Join us, and you’ll get all the benefits of being a part of a global, publicly traded firm – access to industry\-leading technology and thinking and transformational work with big impact and work flexibility. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in each person’s potential, and we’ll help you reach yours. We are a Disability Confident Employer and will offer an interview to applicants who have a disability or long\-term condition, who meet the minimum/essential criteria for the role. Please let us know using this email address ReasonableAccommodationsUKI@aecom.com if you would like to apply through the Disability Confident Interview Scheme. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. **ReqID:** REF59603X **Business Line:** Transportation **Business Group:** DCS **Strategic Business Unit:** Europe \& India **Career Area:** Engineering **Work Location Model:** Hybrid

description: **Summary** From our Head Office to the shop floor and everywhere in between our primary goal is to create and deliver a fantastic customer journey for everyone who shops at Lidl. description: **Job Title:** Graduate Project Engineer **Reporting to:** Project Manager **Business Unit:** Republic of Ireland As a specialized subsidiary of VINCI Energies, Omexom acts as an EPC contractor (Engineering, Procurement, Construction) to offer turnkey solutions for the design, supply, installation, maintenance, and commissioning of electrical infrastructures for a varied range of electricity utility companies and renewable energy developers throughout the UK and Ireland. The current team aims to strengthen its skills and demonstrate its commitment to early career engineers by offering a graduate programme that includes both specialized learning and a comprehensive view of the activity. As part of the development of our activities in Ireland, we are recruiting for graduates to join us for an initial 2\-year placement programme. **Role Purpose** The successful applicant will work under the guidance of experienced Engineers and Project Managers, gaining hands\-on experience across civil, mechanical, and electrical disciplines while developing the technical and leadership skills required for their future career. The Graduate Project Engineer will provide support to the Project Manager for our electricity substation/Renewables operational teams, serving as the main support function, ensuring effective information flow, identifying design risks, and making sure that design outputs comply with Works Information and technical standards. The Graduate Project Engineer collaborates closely with design engineers, planners, document controllers, commercial teams, and project managers. They help manage the program, documentation, meetings, and design interfaces to ensure successful project delivery. The role may require regular travel across the island of Ireland, and the UK, to visit various project sites as required. **Responsibilities \& Duties** Including but not limited to the following: **1\. Data Analysis and D\&E Programme Updates** * Assist the Design Delivery Manager in maintaining the D\&E Management Report using the Project Deliverables Tracker. * Help the Design Delivery Manager in updating the Project Weekly and Monthly reports based on the D\&E Management Report. * Gather and analyse data from various sources. * Monitor deliverables, including incoming items, internal reviews, and submissions. * Assist in developing and updating the D\&E Programme. **2\. Design Assurance \& Documentation Management** * Prepare meeting minutes. * Support compliance checking against standards and governance processes. **3\. Change, TQs \& RFI Management** * Maintain registers for Design Changes, Early Warnings (EWNs), Compensation Events (CEs), Project Manager Instructions (PMIs), Technical Queries (TQs) and Request for Information (RFIs). * Ensure correct routing of technical queries between teams. * Provide early warning of potential issues to the Design Delivery Manager. **4\. Interface \& Communication** * Act as a link between Design Engineers and Design Delivery Manager. * Support stakeholder communication, document control and coordination. * Assist in ensuring design intent is communicated clearly to construction teams. **5\. Risk \& Safety Support** * Support the Design Delivery Manager in identifying and documenting design risks. * Ensure CDM 2015 Regulations compliance data is captured and stored appropriately. **6\. Team \& Improvement Contribution** * Promote collaboration and cross\-disciplinary coordination. * Support lessons learned collection and dissemination. **Key Interfaces** Relationships with key stakeholders: * Design Delivery Manager. * Design Teams (internal and external). * Project Managers. * Planning Team. * Client Representatives. **Person Specification** **Qualifications and Experience** The jobholder shall hold a degree in a relevant discipline, preferably in Electrical Engineering. They should also possess; * Excellent team ethic, and ability to work on your own initiative. * Ability to communicate with people at all levels, both internally and externally, developing positive relationships with customers through good professional conduct. * Ability to work accurately and methodically under pressure and strict deadlines, including the ability to juggle multiple tasks. * Time and cost management skills to ensure cost\-effective and accurate delivery. * Effectively manage own time across multiple tasks and prioritise workload. * Ability to work well within a team of other professionals in delivering designs to satisfy the Scope of Works. **Essential** * Mandatory Omexom training courses. * Full ROI Driving Licence. **Desirable** * CIGRE / IEEE / IET Membership. **Competencies** Required skills, knowledge, and abilities: * Computer Programming Skills (Python Language, Visual Basic for Applications, Matlab). * Computer\-Aided Design Skills (AutoCAD). * Prompt Engineering Skills for Large Language Models (LLMs). * Detail\-oriented mindset. * Ability to put the customer at the centre of decision making. * Commitment to the highest safety and quality\-related standards. **Values** In line with Omexom’s values, the jobholder must have the following qualities: * **Team Spirit \& Generosity** – able to work effectively within and contribute to the Omexom team to deliver results, provide support and drive performance. * **Trust and Empowerment** – enjoy managing their responsibilities and time to ensure work is completed efficiently and professionally. * **Integrity and Responsibility** – enjoy taking responsibility for their duties and managing these effectively to ensure efficient high quality results. * **Innovation \& Entrepreneurship** – continually strive to improve processes and introduce new initiatives to improve efficiency.

statistics and quantitative methods. * Strong logical reasoning and problem\-solving skills. * Basic knowledge of data analysis concepts. * Proficiency in Microsoft Excel. * Excellent attention to detail. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to learn new technologies and analytical tools quickly. **Preferred Skills** * Basic knowledge of **Python** , **R** , or **SQL** . Tableau is an advantage. * Knowledge of MATLAB, Mathematica, or scientific computing tools is beneficial. * Basic understanding of machine learning concepts is advantageous. * Academic research, laboratory projects, dissertations, internships, or computational projects are beneficial but **not required** . **What You'll Gain** * Structured graduate training and mentoring. * Hands\-on applications from graduates of all backgrounds. title: Graduate Surveyor
description: **Job Title** Graduate Surveyor**Job Description Summary** This is an exciting opportunity to join one of Ireland's leading real estate advisors and gain exposure to a broad range of property disciplines, clients and asset types. As a Graduate Surveyor, you will work within one of our specialist business lines while benefiting from the experience and expertise of professionals across the wider business. You will receive structured support and mentoring throughout your Assessment of Professional Competence (APC), helping you develop the technical, commercial and professional skills required to achieve Chartered Surveyor status through the Society of Chartered Surveyors Ireland (SCSI) and Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors (RICS). competencies.**Job Description** **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **Professional Services \& Client Delivery** * Support the delivery of professional surveying services to a diverse range of clients. * Assist in the preparation of reports, presentations, recommendations and client deliverables. * Undertake research, data analysis and market reviews to support business activities. * Attend client meetings and assist in developing long\-term client relationships. * Contribute to the successful delivery of projects and assignments across the business. ### **Property \& Market Analysis** * Gather and analyse property, financial and market information. * Assist in the preparation of valuations, inspections, surveys and advisory reports, as applicable to your team. Programme. * Build technical knowledge across the commercial property sector. * Attend internal and external training sessions, workshops and networking events. * Seek opportunities to broaden experience through collaboration with other departments and projects. **APC Support and Professional Development** -------------------------------------------- Cushman \& Wakefield is committed to supporting graduates throughout their professional qualification journey. Cushman \& Wakefield is an equal opportunity / affirmative action employer. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to ethnicity, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, marital status, or any other legally protected characteristic. Cushman \& Wakefield is committed to equity in employment, and our goal is to have a diverse, inclusive and barrier\-free workplace. title: Group Financial Accountant
description: **Group Financial Accountant** **Location:** Fassaroe, Bray, Co Wicklow initially, office move to Ballycoolin, Dublin in 2027 **The Role** We are looking for a **Group Financial Accountant** to play a key role in supporting group reporting, monthly consolidation, financial statements and the annual audit process. This is an excellent opportunity for a newly or recently qualified finance professional who wants to build their career in a growing, fast\-moving business. As **Group Financial Accountant** , you will work closely with group finance and wider teams across legal, company secretarial, tax, treasury, commercial finance and operations. You will support technical accounting matters, one\-off transactions, accounting standard updates, internal controls and ongoing finance transformation activity. **What You’ll Be Doing** You will: * Support the preparation of annual Group financial statements under IFRS and assist with delivery of the annual audit. * Produce monthly and quarterly Group reporting deliverables and communicate updates to key stakeholders. * Prepare subsidiary financial statements in line with FRS 101 and FRS 102\. * Analyse monthly subsidiary accounts and work with operations and finance teams to prepare monthly management reporting packs. * Lead monthly and annual intercompany reconciliation processes. * Research, analyse and apply technical accounting standards and guidance, including IFRS updates and accounting treatment for growth\-related activity. * Work with the Group Finance team to improve the use of current and future finance systems and technology. * Support finance transformation projects, driving process efficiencies and improvements. * Assist with the implementation and monitoring of internal controls across the Group. * Facilitate and perform period close activities, including balance sheet reconciliation review and approval. * Work with cross\-functional teams including legal, company secretarial, taxation, treasury and commercial finance. **About You** You will be a qualified or recently qualified finance professional with strong technical accounting knowledge and the ability to work accurately in a busy group finance environment. You will bring: * Newly or recently qualified ACA, ACCA or CIMA status. * Big 4 training would be preferable. * Experience in financial reporting, ideally within industry. * Exposure to IFRS, FRS 101 and FRS 102\. * Experience in consolidations and group accounting. * Strong Microsoft Excel skills and confidence using Microsoft applications. * Workday experience would be an advantage. * Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow tasks through to completion. * A self\-driven, motivated and highly organised approach. * Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively with finance and non\-finance stakeholders. * A team\-focused mindset with the confidence to take ownership of key reporting activities. **Why Join Us?** This **Group Financial Accountant** role offers the opportunity to develop your technical accounting skills, gain exposure to senior stakeholders and play a visible role in supporting group finance activity during a period of significant growth. You will be part of a finance team focused on accuracy, improvement, strong controls and better use of systems and data across the business.

title: Healthcare Assistant (Theatre) - UPMC Sports Surgery Clinic, Dublin
description: Location: Sports Surgery Clinic Job type: Permanent **Overview Of Role** UPMC Sports Surgery Clinic are currently recruiting for the role of Healthcare Assistant in our Theatre department. **Primary Duties And Responsibilities** * Respect the privacy and dignity of patients whilst carrying out planned care duties. * Present for duty in a professional manner, punctually and correctly dressed according to Theatre policy. * Help with patient mobility by accompanying patients when walking. * Assist Consultants as leg holder in Theatre for procedures. * Assist with moving and positioning patients under the direction of the Anaesthetist and nursing staff. * Moving patients between theatre table, beds, trolley’s using sliding roll board with support from the theatre staff, following the manual handling assessment of individual patients. * Communicate and pass on relevant information to the ward team. * Communicate verbally with Theatre staff and colleagues on issues relating to work schedules or any problems on a daily basis. * Attend departmental and team meetings. * Attend mandatory training e.g. CPR, Patient Moving \& Manual Handling, Fire Training etc. * Communicate verbally with patients in a professional manner. * Ensure the segregation of clinical and non\-clinical waste according to SSC waste policy when disposing of waste, and ensure that other staff are aware of and follow the policy. * Under the supervision of nursing staff, assist with training and supervision of new support staff while they are being orientated and inducted by showing them around the area, advising of the theatre routine. * Under the direct supervision of nursing staff, check all medical equipment required for theatre lists including diathermy, suction, tourniquet, camera, screens, light source theatre lighting, ensuring that the ventilation is on and working, as trained and in line with national theatre protocols. * Daily check stock level and replenish ensuring the environment is prepared for clinical activity. * Stock up supplies, pharmaceutical products on a daily basis. * Transport of instruments to theatre and return it to the correct allocated places. * Escorting patient that have undergone local anaesthetic back to the Day Ward. * Check serile instrument set contents lists, reporting any missing instruments, incorrect instruments and broken instrumentation to CSSD and Theatre Manager/CNM1, according to theatre policy. * Under the supervision of nursing staff, help maintain a sterile field whilst setting up the procedure trolleys, opening up packaging and equipment in a sterile manner. * Under the supervision of nursing staff, help with patient positioning, setting up of theatre equipment, including diathermy, suction, fluids and camera. * Be constantly aware of theatre scrub nurses’ needs, obtaining any extra equipment, swabs, sutures, dressings etc. as requested. * Dispose of bodily fluids; tissue and clinical waste according to training and in line with trust policy on a daily basis. * Ensure that the anesthetic rooms, recovery and day ward are adequately stocked with sheets, blankets, pillows and pillow cases. * Ensure that the operating tables are ready and waiting in the anaesthetic rooms for the next day and between cases. * Transfer patients from Recovery to Day Ward with a Staff Nurse. * Work with transport Nurse team transferring patients from Recovery to the Inpatient ward and bring patients from Inpatient ward to the theatres with the transport Nurses. When working as part of transport team take instruction of duties from Transport Nurse. * Clean trolleys and take them back to the Day Ward. Assist in the cleaning down and preparing bed bays, post patient discharge from the Day Ward. * Ensure that linen basket and bags are available in the sluice room. * Ensure that the dirty laundry is taken to the ground floor. * Check that the Prep Rooms are stocked for the following day. * Ensure that there are enough dressing gowns in the Day Ward for the following day. * Check all theatres to ensure that the Scavenging System is turned off. * Remove clinical waste bags from bins and replace with new clinical waste bags at the end of every shift in theatre, anaesthetic room and dirty utility rooms. * Check and replace all sharp bins as necessary. * Participate with the cleaning of theatre and equipment between patient visits and at the end of lists, in line with Theatre Policy. * Spot clean areas in the event of spillage of bodily fluids and other substances. * Report equipment failures to the Theatre Manager/CNM1s. In line with theatre policy. * Report any Health and Safety/hazards, Manual Handling and Infection Control issues to the Theatre manager/CNM1s. * Work with the Theatre Manager/CNM1s to ensure a safe environment is maintained in order to safeguard the welfare and safety of patients, staff and visitors. **Qualifications \& Experience** Fetac Level 5 Qualification or similar relevant required. **Experience** Previous experience of working in a caring profession is desirable. Have the ability to undertake the physical demands of the role. Be motivated and able to identify potential difficulties and formulate solutions. Be free from any defect or disease which would render him/her unsuitable to hold office and be in a state of health as would indicate a reasonable prospect of ability to render regular and efficient service. Be of good character. This job description is intended to be an outline of the areas of responsibility. As UPMC and the post holder develop, this job description may be subject to review in light of the changing needs of the business. **Salary Scale:** €36,069 \- €42,177 based on a 39 hour working week. Incremental credit will apply to the salary. **Equal Opportunity Statement And Benefits** **UPMC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.** At UPMC we provide a total rewards program that is not only market competitive, but fair and provides growth opportunities for all our colleagues. **Performance and Recognition** – Rewards for performance that supports the goals and mission of UPMC through our annual ACES programme. **Development and Career Opportunities** – Opportunities for each employee to reach their career goals through continued learning and/or advancement. **About UPMC** UPMC is a renowned multinational academic medical centre committed to delivering people\-focused care that’s close to home. Headquartered in Pittsburgh and affiliated with the University of Pittsburgh Schools of the Health Sciences, UPMC shapes the future of health through clinical and technological innovation, research and education. UPMC expands its expertise globally, bringing world\-class care across continents through its UPMC International division — an owned and operated network of hospitals and ambulatory care centres in Italy, Ireland and Croatia. UPMC International brings new access to the signature specialty services of UPMC Hillman Cancer Centre, UPMC Sports Medicine and others to more people in more places around the world. In Ireland UPMC has provided high\-quality healthcare in the South East since 2006\. UPMC’s operations in Ireland now include UPMC Whitfield Hospital in Waterford, UPMC Sports Surgery Clinic in Dublin, UPMC Kildare Hospital in Clane, and UPMC Aut Even Hospital in Kilkenny. Outpatient care is available at the UPMC Carlow Outreach Centre, UPMC Hillman Cancer Centre radiotherapy locations in Waterford and Cork, UPMC The 4th Practice in Mallow, and across UPMC Sports Medicine Clinics in Dublin, Waterford, Limerick, Tipperary, Cork, and Mayo. UPMC has also established a nationwide Concussion Network. UPMC's Global Technology Operation Centre is based in Kilkenny.

title: Indaver International Graduate Program (IIGP)
description: **What will your working day look like?** First things first—apply! We’re excited to hear from you. Send us your application, and we’ll carefully review it. Your journey begins with your first assignment, where you’ll gain hands\-on experience and start developing your personal growth plan. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations. There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world. We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us. **Job Description** We’re looking for talented and motivated students to join our Highways, Active Travel and Infrastructure team of more than150\+ staff.on an Industrial Placement, where you’ll gain hands\-on experience, contribute to real projects, and develop technical skills that will kick\-start your career. As part of AECOM’s Transportation business line, you’ll work alongside experienced engineers and technicians to help design, develop, and improve highway infrastructure that supports safe, efficient, and sustainable travel. AECOM are recognised as market leaders in highways, public transport and active travel. The team continues to deliver high\-profile and impactful projects across the island of Ireland. **What you’ll do:** Your placement will give you exposure to a variety of highways, public transport and active travel engineering tasks, which may include: * Supporting the design and development of highways, roads, junctions, and associated infrastructure. * Assisting with highway alignment, geometric design, and the preparation of engineering drawings using industry\-standard software. * Supporting the assessment and development of highway improvement schemes from feasibility through to detailed design. * Assisting with the preparation of technical reports, specifications, drawings, and other project documentation. * Working with engineers to analyse technical information, survey data, and existing highway conditions. * Supporting the design of sustainable transport infrastructure, including walking, cycling, and public transport facilities. * Assisting with drainage, earthworks, pavement, and other elements of highway infrastructure where appropriate. * Developing an understanding of relevant design standards, guidance, and legislation. * Working collaboratively with engineers, technicians, project managers, and other disciplines to deliver projects for clients. * Attending site visits and gaining practical experience of how highway projects are developed and delivered. * Preparing presentations and contributing to meetings with clients and project stakeholders. **Qualifications** * Currently pursuing a degree in Civil Engineering, Transportation/Traffic Engineering, Highway Engineering, or a related discipline. * Demonstrable interest in highway engineering and the design and development of safe, efficient, and sustainable transport infrastructure. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and numerical skills, with the ability to interpret and evaluate technical information. * Effective teamworking and communication skills, with the ability to present ideas clearly to colleagues and project stakeholders. * Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. * Strong attention to detail, with good research, technical writing, and report\-writing skills. * A self\-motivated and enthusiastic approach, with a willingness to learn new software, tools, and technical methodologies. **Additional Information** * Applicants are encouraged to apply as early as possible since CVs will be reviewed, and candidates selected for an advanced offer start. * Please include a covering letter with your application and provide all predicted and/or obtained academic grades. * You must have permanent right to work in the Republic of Ireland as we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position. At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.*** **About AECOM** AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public\- and private\-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm and its Professional Services business had revenue of $16\.1 billion in fiscal year 2025\. See how we are delivering sustainable legacies for generations to come at aecom.com and @AECOM. **Freedom to Grow in a World of Opportunity** You will have the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you’re working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed. You will help us foster a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients. AECOM provides a wide array of compensation, benefits and well\-being programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too. Join us, and you’ll get all the benefits of being a part of a global, publicly traded firm – access to industry\-leading technology and thinking and transformational work with big impact and work flexibility. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in each person’s potential, and we’ll help you reach yours. We are a Disability Confident Employer and will offer an interview to applicants who have a disability or long\-term condition, who meet the minimum/essential criteria for the role. Please let us know using this email address ReasonableAccommodationsUKI@aecom.com if you would like to apply through the Disability Confident Interview Scheme. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Intellectual Disability Care Assistant
description: "Enabling people with an intellectual disability to have full and meaningful lives through quality person\-centred services in partnership with families" Cheeverstown is a voluntary organisation, regulated by the Health Information \& Quality Authority (HIQA). We provide a wide range of person\-centred services, including residential, respite, and day services to almost 400 adults with an intellectual disability in the south Dublin area. We are seeking applications from energetic and enthusiastic individuals to join our team as Care Assistants to provide care and support through a person\-centred approach which promotes the person's development and growth and participation in their local communities. We have permanent and specified purpose contracts available for Full\-time hours (39hr) and part\-time hours (19\.5hr) . Candidates must be highly motivated, creative, and experienced, with a passion for engaging with the people we support on a daily basis. In order to promote and support community integration for the individuals supported by Cheeverstown. The role of a Care Assistant is significant in a person's life. The work is rewarding, varied, and interesting. ***The Role:*** * Plan and deliver supports that are person\-centred, which will enable people to have full and meaningful lives. * Respond to individual needs, interests and desires in planning and delivering supports. * Support people to access community\-based services and opportunities, enabling people to develop relationships and roles to ensure people are included and valued in their own communities. * Work to maximise opportunities for people to meet their potential. ***Person specification*** **Essential:** * A FETAC/QQI Level 5 Major Award in Social Care/ Healthcare or relevant qualification\- all 8 modules completed. * Be knowledgeable of the Health Act 2007 and have experience and understanding of the HIQA Regulations * Values that correspond with Cheeverstown's values. * Possess a full, clean driver's license and willingness to drive * Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including good listening skills. * A person\-centred approach to the provision of supports, including an understanding of the individual needs and abilities of each person. * Flexibility to work in all areas of Resident Services. * Openness to providing support across a variety of activities. * Commitment and dedication to enhancing the lives of people with intellectual disabilities and autism. * Good IT and administrative skills. **Desirable:** * One year's experience working in the area of disability is preferable. * Experience supporting people with autism. Induction weeks are provisionally scheduled to commence on 1th October and 9th of November. **Please note:** All job offers are subject to two successful references, ongoing Garda Vetting, completion of mandatory training (online \& onsite) and a satisfactory pre\-employment medical. Salary will be paid at the Care Assistant grade on the HSE Consolidated Salary Scales, depending on qualifications and experience.

title: Junior  Inside Sales Representative

title: Junior Business Developer
description: We are looking for a driven, curious and resilient Business Development Representative to join our growing sales team. As the engine of our new\-business pipeline, you'll be the first point of contact for prospective customers \- researching target accounts, opening conversations through outbound outreach, and uncovering opportunities for our Google Cloud and Google Workspace solutions. Working closely with our sales team and CEO, you'll play a key role in generating qualified pipeline and fuelling the company's growth. **What You'll Do** ● Prospect Proactively: Research and identify target accounts and decision\-makers, building your own list of qualified prospects across your territory. ● Open Conversations: Run multi\-channel outreach \- cold calling, email sequences and LinkedIn/social \- to spark interest and secure meetings for the sales team. ● Qualify Opportunities: Understand each prospect's challenges and goals, positioning Damson Cloud's solutions to uncover genuine opportunities worth pursuing. ● Generate Pipeline: Consistently create and grow qualified pipeline value \- your primary measure of success \- feeding a healthy flow of new business. ● Collaborate Closely: Work hand\-in\-hand with the sales team and CEO to refine messaging, share market insight and hand over well\-qualified opportunities. ● Track Everything: Keep accurate records of your activity and prospects in our CRM (HubSpot), using the data to sharpen your approach and support sales strategy. **Who You Are** ● A Hunter: You get a genuine buzz from opening new doors and chasing opportunities. Rejection doesn't knock you off course \- it sharpens your focus. ● A Self\-Starter: You take ownership from day one, set your own pace and don't wait to be told what to do next. ● Self\-Motivated \& Positive: You bring energy and a can\-do attitude to every day, staying resilient and upbeat through the ups and downs of outbound sales. ● Curious About Technology: You're fascinated by cloud and AI, and eager to keep learning how these tools solve real business problems. ● Built for Remote: You thrive in a fully remote setting \- disciplined, self\-directed and a strong communicator who stays connected with the team from anywhere. **Key Skills** ● Experience: Around 1 year in an outbound sales, BDR/SDR or lead\-generation role \- or the equivalent energy and drive to learn how to do it. ● Outbound Skills: A confident cold caller and strong written communicator, comfortable running email and LinkedIn outreach and handling early objections. ● Commercial Curiosity: Genuinely interested in customers' businesses, with the resilience and persistence that outbound prospecting requires. ● Technical Awareness: General cloud, SaaS or AI knowledge is a distinct advantage; a willingness to learn Google Cloud and Google Workspace is essential. ● Proactive Mindset: Highly motivated, organised and self\-directed, with a track record of hitting targets and managing your own workload. ● Systems Knowledge: Comfortable using CRM systems to manage prospecting activity and pipeline. ● Communication: Fluency in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills

title: Junior Copywriter
description: Who Are We? Decentralized Masters is at the forefront of DeFi education globally. In just a few years, we've grown from two founders to a team of 150\+ professionals, including 35\+ dedicated research analysts. We're recognized as one of the fastest\-growing companies in the sector, with industry insiders predicting our evolution into a unicorn company by 2030\. Operating on a fully bootstrapped model \- no outside investors, no growth hacks \- we're on track to hit $50 million in revenue this year alone. Our Impact While our growth speaks for itself, we're most proud of the impact we've had on our members. To date, we've helped over 5,000 members worldwide grow and protect their wealth through decentralized finance. At Decentralized Masters, we don't just offer education \- we build a powerhouse of knowledge paired with an engaged community, cutting\-edge technology, and a team of leading DeFi and blockchain experts, all in service of one goal: helping our members achieve long\-term success in DeFi and Web3\. Our Vision Our goal is to build the largest and most influential DeFi ecosystem the world has ever seen, starting with becoming the undisputed gold standard in DeFi education. It's an ambitious, transformative vision \- and one that's already reshaping the landscape of digital finance. Are You Ready? This is more than a job. It's a chance to help shape the future of Web3 education, one word at a time. If you're ready to sharpen your craft inside a fast\-moving, mission\-driven company, we want to hear from you. What Will You Be Doing? As a Junior Copywriter on our Renewals team, you'll write the words that keep our members engaged, informed, and excited to continue their journey with Decentralized Masters. You'll work closely with our Membership Directors and Renewals team to craft copy that re\-engages members at renewal time and helps them see the ongoing value of their membership. * Renewal Campaigns: Write emails, SMS, and in\-app messaging that drive membership renewals \- from early reminders to last\-chance offers. * Retention \& Reoffer Copy: Partner with Membership Directors to write persuasive reoffer and downsell messaging for members considering leaving. * Member Storytelling: Turn member wins, testimonials, and success stories into compelling proof points that support renewal campaigns. * Lifecycle Content: Support broader renewal\-lifecycle content, including one\-pagers, landing pages, and follow\-up sequences. * Testing \& Iteration: A/B test subject lines, CTAs, and messaging angles, then use the results to sharpen future campaigns. * Cross\-Team Collaboration: Work alongside senior copywriters, marketers, and mentors to make sure every piece of copy sounds like Decentralized Masters and speaks directly to our members' goals. **Requirements** What You'll Bring * 1\+ year of copywriting experience (agency, in\-house, or freelance) with a portfolio that shows clear, persuasive writing \- recent graduates with a strong portfolio are welcome to apply. * A genuine interest in finance, blockchain technology, and the democratization of financial services (crypto experience is a plus, not a requirement). * Strong writing fundamentals \- grammar, clarity, and the ability to match tone across formats (email, SMS, web). * An eagerness to learn retention and lifecycle marketing copywriting, with curiosity about what makes people stay. * A collaborative mindset and openness to feedback \- you'll work closely with mentors and senior copywriters who will help you grow fast. * Comfort managing multiple copy requests and deadlines in a fast\-paced, remote environment. **Benefits** What Do We Offer You? * Competitive salary * Full\-time, 40 hours/week * Unlimited PTO * Flexible, remote\-first schedule \- work where you thrive * Annual team offsite \- once a year, the whole team meets in person * Direct mentorship from elite operators across finance and crypto * A young, dynamic team of 160\+ professionals across the globe * Rated 4\.9/5 on Glassdoor \- 32% above average for Financial Services employers If you're ready to sharpen your copywriting skills, help members stay and grow with Decentralized Masters, and be part of a team shaping the future of crypto finance, we want to hear from you!

title: Junior Sourcing Consultant

description: **Company Description** Arista Networks is an industry leader in data\-driven, client\-to\-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. engineering). * Familiarity with scripting (e.g. Python) * Basic understanding of the Linux operating system. * Excellent problem\-solving and analytical abilities. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, as well as collaboration skills. **Additional Information** * The candidate must be able to complete a 6\-month onsite internship working a full\-time schedule. * Candidate must be eligible to work in the Republic of Ireland (no work VISA sponsored)

title: Procurement Administrator (Chinese Speaking)
description: The Opportunity WaterWipes has built a global brand by challenging convention and focusing on what matters most. Behind that success is a network of trusted suppliers and partners who help us deliver quality products to families around the world. We're looking for a **Procurement Administrator (Chinese Speaking)** to support our Procurement team and strengthen our engagement with China\-based suppliers. This role sits at the heart of supplier communication, procurement administration and supply chain coordination, ensuring information flows clearly, actions are followed through and priorities keep moving. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working across cultures, building relationships and bringing structure and organisation to a fast\-moving environment. What You'll Be Accountable For * Providing day\-to\-day administrative support to the Procurement team. * Acting as a translator during supplier meetings and communications between English and Chinese\-speaking stakeholders. * Capturing meeting notes, key actions and agreed outcomes, ensuring timely follow\-up. * Maintaining accurate supplier records, procurement documentation and tracking tools. * Supporting supplier onboarding activities and coordinating required documentation. * Assisting with sourcing activities across raw materials, equipment, parts and operational requirements. * Tracking supplier actions, delivery commitments and shipment schedules. * Coordinating communication with suppliers and logistics providers to ensure visibility of risks and delays. * Working closely with Procurement, Supply Chain, Quality, Engineering, Manufacturing and Brand teams to support business priorities. * Identifying opportunities to improve administrative processes and supplier communication practices. Who This Role Is For This role is suited to someone who is highly organised, detail\-oriented and enjoys working with people from different cultures and backgrounds. You may already have experience in procurement, supply chain, logistics, administration or supplier coordination. Equally, you may bring strong business translation experience and be looking to develop your career within a global procurement environment. You will be someone who takes ownership of your work, follows through on commitments and enjoys bringing clarity and structure to complex activities. Most importantly, you will be confident communicating in both English and Chinese and comfortable supporting conversations with suppliers across different time zones. What Will Make You Successful Here * Fluency in written and spoken English and Chinese. * Strong administrative and organisational skills. * Excellent attention to detail and accuracy. * Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines. * Confidence communicating with suppliers and internal stakeholders. * Strong follow\-up and action\-tracking skills. * A proactive approach to problem solving and continuous improvement. * Experience within procurement, supply chain, manufacturing, logistics or supplier\-facing environments would be advantageous. * Exposure to ERP systems, supplier onboarding or international sourcing would be beneficial. Why Join WaterWipes At WaterWipes, you will join a business that values ownership, accountability and practical problem solving. You will work with colleagues across multiple functions and gain exposure to a global supplier network, helping to support procurement activities that have a direct impact on business performance. We move quickly, encourage people to take responsibility and value those who bring ideas, energy and a willingness to make things better. If you are looking for a role where your contribution matters and where you can continue to develop professionally, this could be the opportunity for you. Location \& Practicalities * Full\-time permanent position * Based at our Drogheda Headquarters * Office\-based role * Global supplier exposure with regular interaction with China\-based suppliers Call to Action If you are fluent in Chinese and English and enjoy working in a role that combines communication, organisation and supplier coordination, we'd like to hear from you. Apply today and tell us how your experience can help support Procurement excellence at WaterWipes. WaterWipes® was created by our founder Edward McCloskey after his newborn daughter developed a nappy rash on her sensitive skin. After an extensive search he couldn’t find a baby wipe that didn’t contain numerous ingredients, so he decided to make his own. Many years later and after a lot of hard work, testing, and scientific research, WaterWipes® was born. Pure and gentle for the most delicate skin but in the convenience of a baby wipe, WaterWipes® are purer than cotton wool and water. Every day, parents around the world are discovering the benefits of our gentle and effective WaterWipes® for their baby’s skin. We hope you like them too.

title: Screening Analyst
description: **About Albany Beck** Albany Beck is an award\-winning consultancy specialising in Technology, Risk and Compliance primarily within Financial Services. We work with top tier Investment Banks, Asset Management firms, Hedge Funds and FinTechs. **Client Deployment Role Description** Albany Beck is seeking Junior Screening Analysts to support a critical Financial Crime remediation programme with a leading organisation in Ireland. The client has identified a screening issue which has resulted in a significant backlog of alerts requiring investigation and resolution. As part of a focused remediation initiative, successful candidates will support the review and clearance of screening alerts across sanctions, Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) and adverse media screening. This is an excellent opportunity for analysts with approximately 1\+ years of screening experience to gain exposure to a large\-scale remediation programme while working alongside an established Financial Crime team. The initial engagement will be for three months, with the potential for extension depending on programme progress and business requirements. **Key Responsibilities** * Review and investigate sanctions, PEP and adverse media screening alerts. * Analyse customer information against watchlist data to assess potential matches. * Determine whether alerts represent genuine matches or false positives. * Document clear and concise rationale for screening decisions. * Escalate potential positive matches in accordance with established procedures. * Conduct additional research and gather supporting information where required. * Maintain accurate records of all investigations and outcomes. * Support the timely reduction of the client’s screening alert backlog. * Ensure all work is completed in line with regulatory and internal policy requirements. * Collaborate closely with Financial Crime, Compliance and Operations stakeholders. **Key Skills \& Experience** * Experience working within Financial Crime, AML or Compliance functions. * Approximately 1\+ years of hands\-on screening experience. * Practical knowledge of: * Sanctions Screening * PEP Screening * Adverse Media Screening * Experience investigating alerts and documenting outcomes. * Strong analytical and investigative skills. * Excellent attention to detail and decision\-making ability. * Strong written communication and case documentation skills. * Ability to work efficiently within a structured process\-driven environment. * Comfortable working with Excel\-based case management and reporting data. **Desirable Experience** * Experience within retail banking, payments, fintech or regulated financial services environments. * Exposure to AML, KYC, CDD or EDD processes. * Experience supporting remediation, lookback or backlog\-clearing exercises. * Knowledge of financial crime regulations and screening best practices. * Previous experience working on high\-volume alert review activities.

title: Software Engineer Graduate 2026/2027
description: **Company Description** Arista Networks is an industry leader in data\-driven, client\-to\-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. What sets us apart is our relentless pursuit of innovation. We leverage the latest advancements in cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and software\-defined networking to provide our clients with a competitive edge in an increasingly interconnected world. Our solutions are designed to not only meet the current demands of the digital landscape but to also anticipate and adapt to future challenges. At Arista we value the diversity of thought and perspectives that each employee brings to the table. We believe that fostering an inclusive environment, where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome, is essential for driving creativity and innovation. Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as Best Engineering Team, Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work\-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest standards of quality and performance in everything we do. **Job Description** **Who You'll Work With** Arista Networks is looking for Graduate Engineers interested in learning world leading product development in C/C\+\+, Go, Java, and other languages. Join us at Arista Networks advancing the Software Defined Networking (SDN) revolution. **What You’ll Do** * Writing Linux user space and kernel code to allow 32\-bit drivers to DMA 64\-bit virtual memory spaces using both Intel and AMD IOMMU controller. * Working on the hardware/software boundary for chips and the kernel. Where an x86 chip might have tens of registers, you will routinely work on ASICs with thousands of registers, tables, and special TCAM memories. You will program networking chips to provide latency analysis and keep accurate counts of events happening billions of times per second. You will write Python to bootstrap new hardware. You will build software agents that mediate and translate between the requirements of switching ASICs, high capacity custom FPGAs, media adapters, and PCIe bridges. You might tune lasers and measure and correct error rates measured in parts per billion. * Implementing communications protocols between routers and switches at layer 2 (such as LLDP, 802\.1x, BFD, etc), and layer 3 (such as BGP, OSPF, ISIS). * Updating the forwarding state of the hardware, using platform\-independent abstractions. * Reconciling the linux kernel routing model with the switch's forwarding state. * Implementing a policy language used for filtering and manipulating routing data received and advertised to peers * Accessing ASIC registers over SPI bus, SMbus, PCIe and I2C, to implement high resolution timers (sub\-100ns accuracy) and read ASIC hardware specifications to gather near\-real\-time information on large numbers of packet flows and to generate network congestion statistics. * Developing configuration management services using Go and Python to support YANG, OpenConfig, NETCONF and RESTCONF over gRPC, ssh and ssl for standardised switch configuration, combined with tools such as git, gerrit, Jenkins, Slack and Trello. * Developing routing protocol agents (for BGP, OSPF, ISIS) in C/C\+\+ within a Fedora Linux embedded environment. Coding of fault\-tolerant, concurrent agents capable of handling the demands of future data centres where high performance and high availability are basic requirements. Fully automated, developer owned, Python based, continuous test harness with 100s of devices under test at any one moment. **Qualifications** * Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related fields (Bachelor’s, Master’s, PhD) * Any of the following:\- C, C\+\+, Java, Python, Go, react.js, redux.js, node.js Networking, Linux Embedded Systems, Algorithms, Programming, Software Development. * Strong analytical skills * Ability to communicate effectively in a collaborative and highly technical team environment * Intellectual curiosity and passion for solving challenging problems using technology **Additional Information** The working hours will be agreed in advance with the team manager.

title: Support Worker
description: **Support work is an impactful job. It's the reason people get to live life their way.** Join Positive Futures as a Support Worker and help people with a learning disability, acquired brain injury or autism to live independently, and to have real choice and control over their own lives. You don't need formal qualifications or experience for this role, just kindness, patience, and a sense of fun. You'll get to know the person you're supporting properly: their goals, their routines, what independence looks like for them. From there, you'll support them with everything from daily living skills and personal care, to getting out into their community, keeping in touch with the people who matter to them, and speaking up for themselves. * **A proper start:** Receive a full, paid induction before you're expected to hit the ground running, and join a dedicated team who'll support you every step of the way. * **Genuine independence, genuine impact:** Help people manage their homes, their finances, their health and their social lives, all in a way that puts their choices first. * **No experience required, just the right qualities:** If you're kind, patient, and reliable, we'll teach you the rest, and we'll cover your NISCC registration too. If you're looking for work that means something, makes a real difference to people, every day, and you've got the patience and values this role needs, we'd love to hear from you. **About The Role** **Every day looks a little different, because every person you support is different too.** As a Support Worker, you'll form a positive relationship with the person you support, always maintaining appropriate professional boundaries with them and their families. You'll help them look after their home, manage their money and medication as independently as possible, and get the right support from other services when they need it, whether that's a GP, a social worker, or an advocate. You'll support people to stay safe and healthy in every part of their life, including personal care where it's needed, always treating people with dignity and respect. You'll help them get out into their community, stay connected to the people who matter to them, and speak up for themselves, seeking advocacy support where it's needed rather than deciding things for them. You'll also act as a role model for other staff and volunteers, sharing what you learn and helping new colleagues find their feet. Accurate record keeping (incidents, risk assessments, communication logs) is part of the job too, using our usual digital systems. If you can bring warmth, reliability and genuine respect for people's right to choose their own life, this is a role where that really counts. **Required Criteria** * Minimum 6 months experience providing paid or voluntary care or support for someone. * Full, valid IRL/UK/EU/EEA driving licence to meet the requirements of the post. **Desired Criteria** * Previous experience of supporting someone with autism * Recognised Level 5 award relevant to the role * Relevant third level qualification at degree level i.e. social work, psychology, and/or allied health. * Proficiency in using standard office IT applications such as Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook. * Post\-graduate qualification relevant to the role **Salary** €30,569\.00 \- €45,117\.00 per year
