title: Venture Incubation & Acceleration Associate
description: Job Title: Venture Incubation \& Acceleration Associate Location: Trinity East, Dublin Type: Full\-time, In person **About IoT Tribe** IoT Tribe is a global ecosystem builder accelerating the growth and adoption of disruptive, reliable and affordable net\-zero energy technologies. We design and deliver equity\-free accelerators, support startups, and facilitate partnerships with leading corporates and government agencies across energy, smart infrastructure, industrial manufacturing, aerospace and defence. **The role** We are hiring a highly organised and proactive Venture Incubation \& Acceleration Associate to support the smooth delivery of IoT Tribe’s innovation programmes. You will coordinate participant operations, events, mentors and experts, digital platforms, and programme data. Your work will help create a well\-organised, high\-quality experience for startups, corporate partners, experts and colleagues. Your initial focus will be a flagship corporate incubation programme delivered with ESB and in partnership with Trinity. You will also contribute to IoT Tribe’s wider portfolio of acceleration activities as programme needs evolve. This role is well suited to someone early in their career who enjoys creating structure, maintaining reliable systems and helping complex programmes run smoothly. You will be comfortable working independently, while keeping colleagues and stakeholders informed. **What you will do** **Programme delivery and participant experience** * Coordinate day\-to\-day programme operations, including schedules, participant communications, trackers and delivery checklists. * Support participant onboarding by ensuring teams receive the relevant materials, templates, platform access and programme information. * Maintain programme calendars and communicate key dates, deadlines and deliverables clearly and promptly. * Help deliver a consistent, responsive and professional participant experience throughout each programme. **Events and logistics** * Organise the practical delivery of workshops, webinars, networking events, pitch days and ecosystem activities. * Coordinate venue, meeting\-room, attendee, supplier and run\-of\-show logistics at Trinity East and external venues. * Prepare delivery materials and ensure event information is accurate, complete and shared with the right people in advance. **Mentors, experts and stakeholders** * Coordinate mentor and expert engagement, including maintaining records, booking sessions and communicating schedules. * Support mentor and expert onboarding and prepare briefing materials where required. * Maintain clear communication with programme participants, mentors, experts, corporate partners and internal colleagues. **Platforms, data and reporting** * Administer accelerator programmes on IoT Tribe’s digital platform, Tribe Space, including user access, forms, templates, programme resources and content updates. * Maintain accurate programme records and agreed KPIs, including applications, attendance, participation, engagement and completion data. * Prepare reliable information and data inputs for monthly reports and stakeholder presentations by agreed deadlines. * Identify practical opportunities to improve processes, templates, trackers and participant experience. **Recruitment and community support** * Support programme recruitment activities, including distributing application information, coordinating office hours and maintaining applicant communications. * Support alumni, community and ecosystem engagement activities where required. * Work with the Marketing \& Communications team to provide accurate programme information, updates and delivery requirements. * Undertake reasonable ad hoc operational tasks that support programme delivery, particularly during active recruitment, event and programme\-delivery periods. **What success looks like** During your first 6–12 months, you will be expected to: * Maintain accurate schedules, participant records, digital\-platform content and programme communications. * Deliver workshops and events with logistics completed on time and stakeholders appropriately briefed. * Ensure participants, mentors and experts have clear onboarding and reliable access to the systems and information they need. * Provide accurate, timely programme data for monthly reporting and stakeholder updates. * Improve one or more operational processes, such as onboarding, mentor scheduling, event run sheets, programme trackers or data collection. **What you will bring** **Essential** * Up to two years’ relevant professional experience, or demonstrable transferable experience through internships, university projects, volunteering, events or community activity. * Strong organisational skills, close attention to detail and a reliable approach to following through on commitments. * Confidence using Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace, including calendars, shared documents, presentations and spreadsheets. * Clear written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain accurate records and meet agreed deadlines with support from the wider team. * Ability to anticipate operational dependencies, identify risks early and communicate practical solutions. * A proactive, collaborative and service\-oriented approach. * Willingness to learn new digital platforms and systems. * Ability to handle sensitive information appropriately and maintain confidentiality. * Legal authorisation to work in Ireland. **Desirable** * Experience coordinating events, projects, programmes, communities or multi\-stakeholder initiatives. * Familiarity with startups, innovation, energy, technology, higher\-education or corporate\-partnership environments. * Experience with community\-management, CRM, project\-management, low\-code/no\-code or learning\-platform tools. * Basic data analysis and visualisation skills using Excel or Google Sheets, such as filters, formulas, pivots or simple dashboards. **Practical information** * The role is based at Trinity East, Dublin and requires regular in\-person attendance. * Some flexibility in working hours may be required during events, workshops or pitch days, including some evening work. * Some international travel may be required. * We are looking to appoint the successful candidate as soon as possible. Please include your notice period and earliest available start date in your application. **Terms** Salary dependent on qualifications and experience. If you think your profile fits and would like to apply, please send your CV to talent@iottribe.org with a cover letter detailing: 1. Describe one or two programmes, projects, events or initiatives you have helped organise or coordinate. These examples may come from work, an internship, university, volunteering or extracurricular activity. Explain your role, responsibilities and any tools or systems you used. 2. Describe a time you improved the way something was organised or delivered, solved a problem or made a process more efficient. Explain the situation, what you did and the outcome. 3. Explain why you would like to join IoT Tribe and what interests you about supporting innovation programmes. 4. Confirm your notice period and earliest available start date. 5. Confirm that you are legally authorised to work in Ireland. 6. Include your salary expectations.

title: Veterinary Nurse - Small Animal
description: **Veterinary Nurse (RVN) \- Small Animal** **Ark Vetcare Dún Laoghaire, Co. Dublin** **Full\-time, Permanent** **Salary €32,000 to €38,000 DOE** **Join a Supportive and Experienced Team** Ark Vetcare Dún Laoghaire is seeking a Registered Veterinary Nurse to join our busy and well\-established small animal practice. This is an excellent opportunity for both experienced nurses and newly qualified graduates, with full training and ongoing support provided by our experienced team. We are looking for a hard\-working, enthusiastic and motivated individual who is eager to learn and passionate about delivering gold standard patient care. Whether you are just beginning your nursing career or looking for your next opportunity in practice, you will be supported to develop your skills and confidence within a welcoming and collaborative environment. Our team is committed to providing the highest standards of clinical care while maintaining a strong focus on preventative healthcare, including vaccination programmes, dentistry, nutrition, and client education. **The Role** As a Veterinary Nurse within our small animal team, you will play an important role in delivering exceptional patient care across both medical and surgical cases. This is a varied position offering exposure to all aspects of first\-opinion nursing, allowing you to build and develop a broad range of clinical skills. The role includes inpatient care, surgical nursing, anaesthesia monitoring, patient recovery, laboratory work, client communication, and supporting consultations. There will also be a small amount of reception and administrative duties as part of the wider team approach to patient and client care. We are seeking a nurse who enjoys working in a busy environment, demonstrates excellent attention to detail, and is committed to maintaining high clinical standards. Experience is not essential, as comprehensive training and mentorship can be provided for the right candidate. Applicants must be registered, or eligible to register, with the Veterinary Council of Ireland (VCI). **Working Pattern** This is a full\-time permanent position working across five days per week. The rota includes two evening shifts each week, typically Wednesday and Friday from 11:00am to 7:00pm. Remaining shifts vary and generally start at 7:30am, with finishing times dependent on the rota requirements. The role also includes participation in a Saturday rota, working one in every four Saturdays from 8:00am to 2:00pm. There are no Sunday shifts and no out\-of\-hours requirements. Nurses are required to work only one Bank Holiday Monday per calendar year. A 30\-minute unpaid lunch break is included each working day. **Our Practice** Ark Vetcare Dún Laoghaire is a busy, six\-vet, five\-nurse small animal practice that prides itself on delivering excellent clinical care and outstanding client service. The practice is equipped with modern diagnostic and monitoring equipment, including digital radiography, ultrasound, and multi\-parameter monitoring systems, enabling us to provide a high standard of care to our patients. Our veterinary team includes two Veterinary Surgeons holding certificates in Internal Medicine, while one of our Veterinary Nurses has achieved a certificate in Surgical Nursing. This creates an excellent learning environment for nurses looking to expand their knowledge and develop new skills. We work closely as a team, supporting one another while striving to achieve the best possible outcomes for our patients. Gold standard patient care sits at the heart of everything we do. **What We Offer** We are committed to supporting our people and creating a workplace where you can thrive. In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package including generous annual leave, wellbeing support, paid professional memberships, and structured development opportunities. **You Will Have Access To** **Work\-life balance** * 22 days annual leave * Birthday leave **Focus on employee wellbeing** * Paid maternity, paternity and adoptive leave packages * Cycle to Work scheme * EAP and wellbeing centre access * Paid bereavement leave * Company sick pay **Development** * €600 annual CPD allowance with 3 days' paid CPD leave (pro rata) * Bespoke Graduate Nurse Academy, Nurse Evolve and many more in\-house academies * Funding for Certificates, Diplomas and PhDs * Leadership Academy for future leaders, including Head Nurses and Practice Managers * Career progression opportunities **Professional Memberships** * VCI membership paid * VDS cover paid **Additional Benefits** * Annual pay reviews * Pawsome benefits \- retail discounts, virtual gym and more * Employee pension contributions * Discounted staff pet veterinary fees * Free flu jabs * Opportunity to join company programmes including LGBTQIA\+, Wellbeing Champions, Clinical Board and many more **Why Join Us** At Ark Vetcare Dún Laoghaire, we combine high clinical standards with a genuinely supportive and friendly team culture. We value enthusiasm, teamwork and a willingness to learn, and we are committed to helping every member of our team reach their full potential. This is an exciting opportunity to join a busy and progressive small animal practice where you will gain hands\-on experience across both medical and surgical nursing while working alongside experienced veterinary professionals who are passionate about supporting the next generation of veterinary nurses. Whether you are a newly qualified graduate looking for your first role or an experienced RVN seeking a fresh challenge, we would love to hear from you. €32,000 \- €38,000 a year Up to €38,000 DOE We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
